title: Binance dibobol ±US$6,3 miliar: hack crypto terbesar sepanjang sejarah?
summary: Menurut TRM Labs, Binance jadi korban serangan senilai sekitar US$6,3 miliar di 10 blockchain, sebagian besar dana tersedot dalam ±20 menit.
key_points: Menurut TRM Labs, sekitar US$6,36 miliar keluar dari wallet Binance di 10 blockchain; sebagian besar dalam ±20 menit mulai 20.05 UTC, 29 Oktober 2026 (04.05 WITA, 30 Oktober).
Angkanya sekitar 4x lebih besar dari hack Bybit (±US$1,5 miliar, Februari 2025).
Pernyataan awal Binance (30 Okt): laptop seorang DevOps engineer diduga disusupi dan dipakai mengakses service container untuk mengirim penarikan tak sah; tidak ada bukti private key wallet bocor.
TRM Labs dan Chainalysis (keyakinan tinggi) menunjuk grup TraderTraitor asal Korea Utara; FBI menyatakan hal yang sama pada 31 Oktober 2026.
Binance menyebut ±US$3 miliar dibekukan on-chain (30 Okt); hitungan TRM hampir US$2,7 miliar, dengan ±US$2,4 miliar masih dipegang pelaku.
why_it_matters: Binance berjanji mengganti semua kerugian dan menyatakan dana pengguna aman, tetapi kasus ini kembali membuka pertanyaan soal risiko menyimpan crypto di exchange.
body: Menurut TRM Labs, sekitar US$6,36 miliar keluar dari wallet Binance di 10 blockchain pada 29 Oktober 2026. Sebagian besar dana disedot dalam ±20 menit, mulai pukul 20.05 UTC (04.05 WITA, 30 Oktober). Ini pencurian crypto terbesar yang pernah tercatat, sekitar 4x hack Bybit (±US$1,5 miliar, Februari 2025).

Bagaimana bisa terjadi? Dalam pembaruan 30 Oktober, Binance menyatakan investigasi awal mengarah ke laptop seorang DevOps engineer yang disusupi, lalu dipakai untuk mengakses service container dan mengirim transaksi penarikan tak sah. Binance bilang tidak ada bukti private key wallet bocor. Post-mortem Binance berikutnya (3 November) menyebut kampanye ini dimulai sejak Juni lewat installer palsu dan tawaran wawancara kerja palsu.

Siapa pelakunya? TRM Labs dan Chainalysis menunjuk grup TraderTraitor asal Korea Utara dengan tingkat keyakinan tinggi, grup yang sama di balik hack Bybit. Pada 31 Oktober 2026, FBI juga menyatakan peretas Korea Utara berada di balik pencurian ini.

Soal dana yang dibekukan: Binance menyebut ±US$3 miliar sudah dibekukan on-chain per 30 Oktober. Hitungan TRM hampir US$2,7 miliar (antara lain Tether ±1,77 miliar USDT dan Circle ±825 juta USDC), sementara ±US$2,4 miliar masih dipegang pelaku.

Dampaknya: Binance berjanji mengganti semua kerugian lewat dana SAFU dan dana perusahaan, dan menyatakan dana pengguna aman; penarikan sempat dihentikan sementara. Di pasar, BTC turun sekitar 4% dan sempat di bawah US$78.000 pada 30 Oktober.

title_en: Binance hacked for ±US$6.3 billion: the biggest crypto hack in history?
summary_en: According to TRM Labs, Binance was hit by an attack worth about US$6.3 billion across 10 blockchains, with most of the funds drained in ±20 minutes.
key_points_en: According to TRM Labs, about US$6.36 billion left Binance wallets across 10 blockchains, most of it in ±20 minutes starting at 20:05 UTC on 29 October 2026 (04:05 WITA, 30 October).
That is about 4x the Bybit hack (±US$1.5 billion, February 2025).

Binance's initial statement (30 Oct): a DevOps engineer's laptop was likely compromised and used to access a service container to submit unauthorized withdrawals; there is no evidence that wallet private keys leaked.
TRM Labs and Chainalysis (high confidence) point to TraderTraitor, a North Korean group; the FBI said the same on 31 October 2026.
Binance said ±US$3 billion was frozen on-chain (30 Oct); TRM's count is nearly US$2.7 billion, with ±US$2.4 billion still held by the attacker.
body_en: According to TRM Labs, about US$6.36 billion left Binance wallets across 10 blockchains on 29 October 2026. Most of the funds were drained in ±20 minutes, starting at 20:05 UTC (04:05 WITA, 30 October). It is the largest crypto theft on record, about 4x the Bybit hack (±US$1.5 billion, February 2025).

How did it happen? In its 30 October update, Binance said its initial investigation pointed to a compromised DevOps engineer's laptop, which was used to access a service container and submit unauthorized withdrawal transactions. Binance said there is no evidence that wallet private keys leaked. Binance's later post-mortem (3 November) said the campaign began in June through a fake installer and fake job interviews.

Who is behind it? TRM Labs and Chainalysis point with high confidence to TraderTraitor, a North Korean group, the same group behind the Bybit hack. On 31 October 2026, the FBI also said North Korean hackers were behind the theft.

Frozen funds: Binance said ±US$3 billion had been frozen on-chain as of 30 October. TRM counts nearly US$2.7 billion (including ±1.77 billion USDT by Tether and ±825 million USDC by Circle), while ±US$2.4 billion is still held by the attacker.

The impact: Binance promised to cover all losses through its SAFU fund and company funds, and said user funds are safe; withdrawals were temporarily suspended. In the market, BTC fell about 4% and briefly traded below US$78,000 on 30 October.
why_en: Binance promised to cover all losses and said user funds are safe, but the case again raises questions about the risk of keeping crypto on an exchange.
tips_title_en: Safety tips from the COIN BRO caption
tips_en: Use a hardware security key (not SMS 2FA).

title: Rusia buka trading Bitcoin di bursa resmi mulai 1 Desember
summary: Moscow Exchange berencana membuka perdagangan Bitcoin, Ethereum, dan USDT mulai 1 Desember 2026.
key_points: Moscow Exchange berencana membuka perdagangan Bitcoin, Ethereum, dan USDT mulai 1 Desember 2026. Boris Blokhin (senior managing director) menyampaikannya lagi pada 31 Oktober 2026, dan bursa mengumumkannya resmi pada 2 November.
Perdagangan berjalan di infrastruktur pasar saham dengan kliring National Clearing Centre, pukul 06.50–23.50 waktu Moskow; uji coba (pilot) sudah berjalan sejak awal Oktober.
Investor non-kualifikasi wajib lulus tes dan dibatasi maksimal 300.000 rubel per tahun lewat satu broker; investor kualifikasi tidak dibatasi.
Moscow Exchange dan lembaga kliringnya masuk daftar sanksi AS sejak Juni 2024.
why_it_matters: Ini akan menjadi pasar crypto terorganisir pertama di Rusia, di bursa yang sama dengan saham Sberbank dan Gazprom, meski bursanya terkena sanksi AS.
body: Moscow Exchange, bursa terbesar Rusia, berencana membuka perdagangan Bitcoin, Ethereum, dan USDT mulai 1 Desember 2026. Boris Blokhin, senior managing director Moscow Exchange, menyampaikan rencana ini pada 31 Oktober 2026 (Interfax), dan bursa mengumumkannya resmi pada 2 November.

Apa yang direncanakan? Tiga aset awal: BTC, ETH, dan USDT. Perdagangan memakai teknologi pasar saham bursa dan kliring National Clearing Centre, dengan jam trading 06.50–23.50 waktu Moskow. Penyimpanan aset dilakukan lewat depositori digital mitra. Uji coba transaksi sudah berjalan sejak awal Oktober, dan tahap awal peluncuran berupa transaksi pilot.
Siapa yang boleh membeli? Investor non-kualifikasi wajib lulus tes dan dibatasi maksimal 300.000 rubel (±US$3.700) per tahun lewat satu broker, sedangkan investor kualifikasi tidak dibatasi.

Latar belakangnya: UU mata uang digital Rusia (No. 282-FZ) berlaku sejak 1 September 2026, dengan sebagian ketentuan baru berlaku Juli dan September 2027. Moscow Exchange dan National Clearing Centre sendiri berada di bawah sanksi AS sejak Juni 2024, sehingga muncul pertanyaan soal USDT, karena Tether biasa membekukan wallet yang terkena sanksi.

title_en: Russia opens Bitcoin trading on its official exchange from 1 December
summary_en: Moscow Exchange plans to open trading in Bitcoin, Ethereum and USDT from 1 December 2026.
key_points_en: Moscow Exchange plans to open trading in Bitcoin, Ethereum and USDT from 1 December 2026. Boris Blokhin (senior managing director) repeated the plan on 31 October 2026, and the exchange announced it officially on 2 November.
Trading runs on the stock market infrastructure with clearing by the National Clearing Centre, from 06:50 to 23:50 Moscow time; a pilot has been running since early October.
Non-qualified investors must pass a test and are limited to 300,000 rubles per year through one broker; qualified investors have no cap.
Moscow Exchange and its clearing house have been under US sanctions since June 2024.
body_en: Moscow Exchange, Russia's largest exchange, plans to open trading in Bitcoin, Ethereum and USDT from 1 December 2026. Boris Blokhin, senior managing director of Moscow Exchange, described the plan on 31 October 2026 (Interfax), and the exchange announced it officially on 2 November.

What is planned? Three initial assets: BTC, ETH and USDT. Trading uses the exchange's stock market technology and clearing by the National Clearing Centre, with trading hours of 06:50–23:50 Moscow time. Assets are held through partner digital depositories. Test transactions have been running since early October, and the first phase of the launch consists of pilot transactions.
Who can buy? Non-qualified investors must pass a test and are limited to 300,000 rubles (±US$3,700) per year through one broker, while qualified investors have no cap.

Background: Russia's digital currency law (No. 282-FZ) took effect on 1 September 2026, with some provisions taking effect in July and September 2027. Moscow Exchange and the National Clearing Centre have been under US sanctions since June 2024, which raises questions about USDT, since Tether usually freezes sanctioned wallets.
why_en: This will be Russia's first organized crypto market, on the same exchange as Sberbank and Gazprom shares, even though the exchange is under US sanctions.

title: Tether cetak laba US$1,5 miliar di Q3 2026, cadangan lebih naik hampir dua kali lipat
summary: Laporan Q3 2026 yang diatestasi BDO menunjukkan laba operasional bersih Tether US$1,5 miliar dan cadangan lebih US$7,95 miliar.
key_points: Menurut laporan Q3 2026 yang dirilis Tether pada 30 Oktober dan diatestasi BDO, laba operasional bersih Q3 US$1,5 miliar, sama dengan kuartal sebelumnya.
Januari–September 2026: total laba operasional bersih US$4,5 miliar, terutama dari bunga T-bill AS dan reverse repo.
Per 30 September 2026: total aset US$191,5 miliar, total kewajiban US$183,5 miliar. Cadangan lebih naik ke US$7,95 miliar dari US$4,1 miliar di akhir Q2.
Isi cadangan antara lain T-bill AS (langsung dan tidak langsung) US$132,4 miliar, emas US$19,08 miliar, dan Bitcoin US$8,37 miliar (naik dari ±US$5,8 miliar di akhir Juni).
why_it_matters: Cointelegraph mencatat eksposur T-bill AS Tether mendekati kepemilikan surat utang AS milik Korea Selatan (US$134,2 miliar, data Treasury AS per Agustus). Angka laba adalah klaim Tether; atestasi BDO hanya memeriksa posisi aset dan kewajiban per 30 September, bukan audit penuh.
body: Tether, penerbit stablecoin USDT, mencetak laba operasional bersih US$1,5 miliar di kuartal ketiga 2026, dan cadangan lebihnya naik hampir dua kali lipat.

Menurut laporan Q3 2026 yang dirilis Tether pada 30 Oktober dan diatestasi kantor akuntan BDO, laba Q3 sama dengan kuartal sebelumnya. Sepanjang Januari–September 2026, total laba operasional bersih Tether mencapai US$4,5 miliar. Sumber utamanya adalah bunga T-bill (surat utang jangka pendek) AS dan reverse repo.

Cadangan lebih nyaris 2x lipat: per 30 September 2026, total aset Tether US$191,5 miliar, sedangkan total kewajibannya US$183,5 miliar. Selisihnya, atau cadangan lebih, naik ke US$7,95 miliar dari US$4,1 miliar di akhir Q2. Isinya antara lain T-bill AS (langsung dan tidak langsung) US$132,4 miliar, emas US$19,08 miliar, dan Bitcoin US$8,37 miliar.
Sekelas negara: Cointelegraph mencatat eksposur T-bill AS Tether mendekati kepemilikan surat utang AS milik Korea Selatan (US$134,2 miliar, data Treasury AS per Agustus).
analysis: Angka ini menunjukkan bisnis stablecoin sangat bergantung pada suku bunga AS. Kalau bunga turun, pendapatan dari T-bill juga berpotensi ikut turun. Sebagian besar kenaikan cadangan lebih juga datang dari naiknya harga Bitcoin dan emas, yang bisa berbalik.

title_en: Tether posts US$1.5 billion profit in Q3 2026, excess reserves nearly double
summary_en: Tether's Q3 2026 report, attested by BDO, shows US$1.5 billion in net operating profit and US$7.95 billion in excess reserves.
key_points_en: According to Tether's Q3 2026 report, released on 30 October and attested by BDO, Q3 net operating profit was US$1.5 billion, the same as the previous quarter.
January–September 2026: total net operating profit of US$4.5 billion, mainly from US T-bill interest and reverse repos.
As of 30 September 2026: total assets US$191.5 billion, total liabilities US$183.5 billion. Excess reserves rose to US$7.95 billion from US$4.1 billion at the end of Q2.
Reserves include US T-bills (direct and indirect) of US$132.4 billion, gold of US$19.08 billion, and Bitcoin of US$8.37 billion (up from ±US$5.8 billion at the end of June).
body_en: Tether, the issuer of the USDT stablecoin, posted US$1.5 billion in net operating profit in the third quarter of 2026, and its excess reserves nearly doubled.

According to Tether's Q3 2026 report, released on 30 October and attested by accounting firm BDO, Q3 profit matched the previous quarter. Over January–September 2026, Tether's total net operating profit reached US$4.5 billion. The main sources were interest on US T-bills (short-term government debt) and reverse repos.

Excess reserves nearly 2x: as of 30 September 2026, Tether's total assets were US$191.5 billion and its total liabilities US$183.5 billion. The difference, its excess reserves, rose to US$7.95 billion from US$4.1 billion at the end of Q2. Holdings include US T-bills (direct and indirect) of US$132.4 billion, gold of US$19.08 billion, and Bitcoin of US$8.37 billion.
On par with a country: Cointelegraph noted that Tether's US T-bill exposure is close to South Korea's holdings of US government debt (US$134.2 billion, US Treasury data for August).
why_en: Cointelegraph noted that Tether's US T-bill exposure is close to South Korea's holdings of US government debt (US$134.2 billion, US Treasury data for August). The profit figure is Tether's own claim; BDO's attestation only checks assets and liabilities as of 30 September and is not a full audit.
analysis_en: These numbers show the stablecoin business depends heavily on US interest rates. If rates fall, T-bill income could fall too. Most of the rise in excess reserves also came from higher Bitcoin and gold prices, which can reverse.

title: Coinbase untung US$719 juta di Q3 2026, tapi sahamnya anjlok sekitar 13%
summary: Laba bersih naik, tetapi pendapatan total turun 35% dan pendapatan transaksi anjlok sekitar 44%.
key_points: Laba bersih Q3 2026 naik jadi US$718,7 juta (Q3 2025: US$432,6 juta).
Total pendapatan turun 35% jadi US$1,22 miliar; pendapatan transaksi anjlok 44% ke US$590,2 juta.
Laba hampir seluruhnya dari keuntungan aset kripto yang dipegang untuk investasi (US$715 juta); laba operasional hanya US$61,7 juta (Q3 2025: US$480,5 juta).
Pendapatan stablecoin US$306,9 juta. Saham COIN turun sekitar 13% pada 30 Oktober, saat BTC sempat di bawah US$77 ribu.
why_it_matters: Laba besar belum tentu berarti bisnis inti sedang kuat: sebagian besar laba berasal dari kenaikan nilai aset yang dipegang, bukan dari operasional.
body: Coinbase untung US$719 juta di Q3 2026, tapi sahamnya malah anjlok sekitar 13% sehari setelah laporan keluar.

Menurut laporan 10-Q ke SEC, laba bersih Coinbase di kuartal III 2026 naik jadi US$718,7 juta (Q3 2025: US$432,6 juta). Tapi total pendapatannya turun 35% jadi US$1,22 miliar, dan pendapatan transaksi anjlok 44% ke US$590,2 juta.

Labanya hampir seluruhnya berasal dari keuntungan aset kripto yang mereka pegang untuk investasi, sekitar US$715 juta. Laba operasionalnya cuma US$61,7 juta. Yang lumayan menahan: pendapatan stablecoin US$306,9 juta. Saham COIN turun sekitar 13% pada 30 Oktober, di hari yang sama Bitcoin sempat jatuh di bawah US$77 ribu setelah hack Binance.
analysis: Laba besar belum tentu berarti bisnis intinya lagi kuat. Selalu cek labanya datang dari mana.

title_en: Coinbase earns US$719 million in Q3 2026, but its stock drops about 13%
summary_en: Net income rose, but total revenue fell 35% and transaction revenue dropped about 44%.
key_points_en: Q3 2026 net income rose to US$718.7 million (Q3 2025: US$432.6 million).
Total revenue fell 35% to US$1.22 billion; transaction revenue dropped 44% to US$590.2 million.
Almost all of the profit came from gains on crypto assets held for investment (US$715 million); operating income was only US$61.7 million (Q3 2025: US$480.5 million).
Stablecoin revenue was US$306.9 million. COIN shares fell about 13% on 30 October, as BTC briefly dropped below US$77K.
body_en: Coinbase earned US$719 million in Q3 2026, yet its stock dropped about 13% the day after the report came out.

According to its 10-Q filing with the SEC, Coinbase's Q3 2026 net income rose to US$718.7 million (Q3 2025: US$432.6 million). But total revenue fell 35% to US$1.22 billion, and transaction revenue dropped 44% to US$590.2 million.

Almost all of the profit came from gains on crypto assets it holds for investment, about US$715 million. Operating income was just US$61.7 million. What helped hold things up: stablecoin revenue of US$306.9 million. COIN shares fell about 13% on 30 October, the same day Bitcoin briefly dropped below US$77K after the Binance hack.
why_en: A big profit does not necessarily mean the core business is strong: most of the profit came from gains in the value of assets held, not from operations.
analysis_en: A big profit does not necessarily mean the core business is doing well. Always check where the profit comes from.

title: Whitepaper Bitcoin genap 18 tahun hari ini
summary: Pada 31 Oktober 2008, Satoshi Nakamoto mengumumkan paper sembilan halaman tentang uang elektronik peer-to-peer.
key_points: 31 Oktober 2008: paper "Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System" diumumkan lewat milis kriptografi. Jaringan baru berjalan 3 Januari 2009.
Januari 2024: ETF Bitcoin spot di AS disetujui.
Per 31 Oktober 2026 Bitcoin diperdagangkan sekitar US$77.400 dengan nilai pasar sekitar US$1,55 triliun.
Pasokan dibatasi 21 juta koin; lebih dari 95% sudah ditambang.
why_it_matters: Visi awal Bitcoin adalah bertransaksi tanpa pihak ketiga tepercaya. Peringatan ulang tahun ini muncul beberapa hari setelah Binance melaporkan hack sekitar US$6,3 miliar dari hot wallet, sehingga untuk simpanan jangka panjang, self-custody layak dipertimbangkan.
body: Hari ini, 31 Oktober 2026, tepat 18 tahun sejak Satoshi Nakamoto mengumumkan paper sembilan halaman berjudul "Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System" lewat milis kriptografi pada 31 Oktober 2008. Jaringan Bitcoin sendiri baru berjalan pada 3 Januari 2009.

Apa isi paper-nya? Satoshi mengusulkan uang elektronik peer-to-peer yang memungkinkan pembayaran dikirim langsung dari satu pihak ke pihak lain, tanpa lewat lembaga keuangan. Transaksi disiarkan ke jaringan dan dicatat dalam rantai blok yang diamankan proof-of-work, sehingga tidak perlu pihak ketiga tepercaya untuk mencegah double-spending.

Dari 2008 ke 2026: paper diumumkan 31 Oktober 2008; blok pertama ditambang 3 Januari 2009; ETF Bitcoin spot di AS disetujui Januari 2024. Hari ini, Bitcoin diperdagangkan sekitar US$77.400 dengan nilai pasar sekitar US$1,55 triliun. Pasokannya dibatasi 21 juta koin dan lebih dari 95% sudah ditambang.

Momen yang pas untuk bicara kustodi: peringatan ulang tahun ini muncul dua hari setelah hack Binance sekitar US$6,3 miliar dari hot wallet. Binance menyatakan dana pengguna aman dan menyiapkan lebih dari US$6,34 miliar dana perusahaan untuk menutup kerugian.

title_en: The Bitcoin whitepaper turns 18 today
summary_en: On 31 October 2008, Satoshi Nakamoto announced a nine-page paper on peer-to-peer electronic cash.
key_points_en: 31 October 2008: the paper "Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System" was announced on a cryptography mailing list. The network only went live on 3 January 2009.
January 2024: spot Bitcoin ETFs were approved in the US.
As of 31 October 2026, Bitcoin trades at about US$77,400 with a market value of about US$1.55 trillion.
Supply is capped at 21 million coins; more than 95% have already been mined.
body_en: Today, 31 October 2026, marks exactly 18 years since Satoshi Nakamoto announced a nine-page paper titled "Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System" on a cryptography mailing list on 31 October 2008. The Bitcoin network itself only went live on 3 January 2009.

What does the paper say? Satoshi proposed peer-to-peer electronic cash that lets payments be sent directly from one party to another without going through a financial institution. Transactions are broadcast to the network and recorded in a chain of blocks secured by proof-of-work, so no trusted third party is needed to prevent double-spending.

From 2008 to 2026: the paper was announced on 31 October 2008; the first block was mined on 3 January 2009; spot Bitcoin ETFs were approved in the US in January 2024. Today, Bitcoin trades at about US$77,400 with a market value of about US$1.55 trillion. Its supply is capped at 21 million coins and more than 95% have already been mined.

A good moment to talk about custody: the anniversary comes two days after the ±US$6.3 billion Binance hot-wallet hack. Binance said user funds are safe and set aside more than US$6.34 billion of company funds to cover the losses.
why_en: Bitcoin's original vision was to transact without a trusted third party. The anniversary comes days after Binance reported a ±US$6.3 billion hot-wallet hack, so for long-term savings, self-custody is worth considering.

title: Trezor Safe 5 dari Tokopedia diduga dipasangi alat penyadap
summary: Trezor menilai laporan implan perangkat keras pada Trezor Safe 5 dari seorang pembeli di Indonesia kredibel, namun belum memeriksa perangkatnya di lab.
key_points: Perangkat dibeli Agustus 2026 dari CryptoBilis lewat Tokopedia dan dilaporkan ke Trezor pada 28 Oktober. Trezor mencoret CryptoBilis dari daftar reseller pada 9 Oktober 2026.
Trezor belum menerima atau memeriksa perangkatnya, tetapi menilai laporan kredibel berdasarkan deskripsi dan wawancara video. Belum ada pembeli CryptoBilis yang melapor kehilangan dana ke Trezor.

Menurut laporan, ada papan sirkuit tambahan antara mainboard dan layar, lengkap dengan modul seluler dan antena; diduga membaca isi layar (termasuk recovery phrase) dan mengirimnya lewat jaringan seluler.

Ledger menemukan implan serupa di perangkatnya yang dijual CryptoBilis. Terpisah, Polisi Singapura (28 Okt) mencatat minimal 2 Ledger termodifikasi yang dibeli di toko ritel lokal, dengan kerugian sekitar S$3,5 juta.
why_it_matters: Beli hardware wallet hanya dari situs resmi atau reseller resmi yang tercantum di situs brand-nya. Ini masih dugaan yang belum diperiksa di lab oleh Trezor.
body: Trezor menerima laporan dari seorang pembeli di Indonesia soal Trezor Safe 5 yang diduga dipasangi implan perangkat keras. Perangkat itu dibeli pada Agustus 2026 dari CryptoBilis lewat Tokopedia, dan dilaporkan lewat program responsible disclosure Trezor pada 28 Oktober. Trezor sudah mencoret CryptoBilis dari daftar reseller pada 9 Oktober 2026.

Trezor belum menerima perangkat tersebut, tapi menilai laporan ini kredibel berdasarkan deskripsi dan wawancara video dengan pelapor. Sejauh ini belum ada pembeli CryptoBilis yang melaporkan kehilangan dana ke Trezor.

Bagaimana cara kerjanya? Menurut laporan yang belum diverifikasi Trezor, ada papan sirkuit tambahan di antara mainboard dan layar, lengkap dengan modul seluler dan antena. Implan ini diduga membaca isi layar, termasuk recovery phrase, lalu mengirimnya lewat jaringan seluler setiap kali perangkat dicolok.

Bukan kasus pertama: tim Donjon milik Ledger menemukan implan di perangkat Ledger yang dijual CryptoBilis. Secara terpisah, Polisi Singapura pada 28 Oktober mencatat minimal 2 Ledger termodifikasi yang dibeli di toko ritel lokal, dengan total kerugian sekitar S$3,5 juta.

tips: Pindahkan dana ke wallet baru dengan seed baru secepatnya.
Jangan pakai seed lama di perangkat apa pun.

Trezor Support tidak akan pernah meminta recovery phrase. Waspadai phishing yang memanfaatkan kasus ini.

title_en: Trezor Safe 5 bought on Tokopedia allegedly fitted with a spy implant
summary_en: Trezor considers a report of a hardware implant in a Trezor Safe 5 from a buyer in Indonesia credible, but has not yet examined the device in its lab.
key_points_en: The device was bought in August 2026 from CryptoBilis via Tokopedia and reported to Trezor on 28 October. Trezor removed CryptoBilis from its reseller list on 9 October 2026.
Trezor has not yet received or examined the device, but considers the report credible based on the description and a video interview. No CryptoBilis buyer has reported a loss of funds to Trezor.

According to the report, there is an extra circuit board between the main board and the screen, with a cellular module and antenna; it allegedly reads what the screen shows (including the recovery phrase) and sends it over a mobile network.

Ledger found a similar implant in its devices sold by CryptoBilis. Separately, Singapore Police (28 Oct) recorded at least 2 modified Ledgers bought from local retail stores, with losses of about S$3.5 million.
body_en: Trezor received a report from a buyer in Indonesia about a Trezor Safe 5 allegedly fitted with a hardware implant. The device was bought in August 2026 from CryptoBilis via Tokopedia, and reported through Trezor's responsible disclosure program on 28 October. Trezor had already removed CryptoBilis from its reseller list on 9 October 2026.

Trezor has not yet received the device, but considers the report credible based on the description and a video interview with the reporter. So far, no CryptoBilis buyer has reported a loss of funds to Trezor.

How does it work? According to the report, which Trezor has not verified, there is an extra circuit board between the main board and the screen, with a cellular module and antenna. The implant allegedly reads what the screen shows, including the recovery phrase, and sends it over a mobile network whenever the device is plugged in.

Not the first case: Ledger's Donjon team found an implant in Ledger devices sold by CryptoBilis. Separately, Singapore Police on 28 October recorded at least 2 modified Ledgers bought from local retail stores, with total losses of about S$3.5 million.
why_en: Only buy hardware wallets from the official site or an authorized reseller listed on the brand's site. This is still an allegation that Trezor has not examined in its lab.

tips_en: Move your funds to a new wallet with a new seed as soon as possible.
Do not use the old seed on any device.
Not set up yet? Do not use it.
Contact Trezor Support for a replacement device.
Trezor Support will never ask for your recovery phrase. Watch out for phishing that exploits this case.

title: "Bitcoin tidak akan pernah tembus rekor lagi" — lalu ada yang taruhan US$1 juta
summary: Grant Cardone menantang pernyataan Jason Calacanis dengan taruhan US$1 juta; belum ada kesepakatan yang didanai.
key_points: 27 Okt 2026: Jason Calacanis bilang Bitcoin bisa kembali ke sekitar US$57.000 dalam 12 bulan dan "tidak akan pernah" tembus rekor tertingginya lagi.
Grant Cardone menantang dengan taruhan US$1 juta: BTC menyentuh atau melewati rekor US$126.210,50 paling lambat 28 Okt 2028 pukul 12.00 PST.
Terence Michael (syarat sama dengan Cardone) dan Fred Krueger (tenggat 28 Okt 2036) juga menawarkan masing-masing US$1 juta; total tawaran US$3 juta.
Belum ada kesepakatan: Calacanis membalas "So much free money!" dan bertanya soal escrow, tetapi belum menerima tawaran mana pun secara resmi.
why_it_matters: Ini adu opini, bukan prediksi yang terbukti. BTC saat itu sekitar US$78.000, sekitar 38% di bawah rekor; agar taruhan Cardone menang, BTC perlu naik sekitar 62%.
body: Pada 27 Okt 2026, Jason Calacanis (co-host podcast All-In) menulis di X bahwa Bitcoin bisa turun ke US$57.000 dalam setahun dan "tidak akan pernah" tembus rekor tertingginya lagi. Grant Cardone, pendiri Cardone Capital, lalu menantangnya dengan taruhan US$1 juta.
Syarat taruhan Cardone: BTC menyentuh atau melewati rekor US$126.210,50 paling lambat 28 Okt 2028 pukul 12.00 PST. Kalau tidak, Cardone yang membayar US$1 juta ke Calacanis.
Penantang lain ikut masuk: Terence Michael dengan syarat yang sama, dan Fred Krueger dengan tenggat lebih longgar, 28 Okt 2036. Total tawaran taruhan: US$3 juta.
Sudah diterima? Belum. Calacanis membalas "So much free money!" dan bertanya apakah ada escrow atau platform untuk mengunci taruhan, tetapi belum ada kesepakatan resmi.
Selisih harganya: BTC sekitar US$78.000 saat itu, sekitar 38% di bawah rekor. Agar taruhan Cardone menang, BTC perlu naik sekitar 62%.

title_en: "Bitcoin will never break its record again" — then someone bet US$1 million
summary_en: Grant Cardone challenged Jason Calacanis's claim with a US$1 million bet; no funded agreement exists yet.
key_points_en: 27 Oct 2026: Jason Calacanis said Bitcoin could return to about US$57,000 within 12 months and would "never" break its all-time high again.
Grant Cardone challenged him with a US$1 million bet: BTC must reach or exceed the US$126,210.50 record by 12:00 PST on 28 Oct 2028.
Terence Michael (same terms as Cardone) and Fred Krueger (deadline 28 Oct 2036) also offered US$1 million each; total offers US$3 million.
No agreement yet: Calacanis replied "So much free money!" and asked about escrow, but has not formally accepted any offer.
body_en: On 27 Oct 2026, Jason Calacanis (co-host of the All-In podcast) wrote on X that Bitcoin could fall to US$57,000 within a year and would "never" break its all-time high again. Grant Cardone, founder of Cardone Capital, then challenged him with a US$1 million bet.
Cardone's terms: BTC must reach or exceed the US$126,210.50 record by 12:00 PST on 28 Oct 2028. If not, Cardone pays Calacanis US$1 million.
Other challengers joined: Terence Michael on the same terms, and Fred Krueger with a looser deadline of 28 Oct 2036. Total bets offered: US$3 million.
Accepted? Not yet. Calacanis replied "So much free money!" and asked whether there is an escrow or platform to lock in the bet, but there is no official agreement.
The price gap: BTC was about US$78,000 at the time, about 38% below the record. For Cardone to win, BTC needs to rise about 62%.
why_en: This is a clash of opinions, not a proven prediction. BTC was about US$78,000 at the time, about 38% below the record; for Cardone to win, BTC needs to rise about 62%.

title: Pentagon punya program rahasia terkait Bitcoin?
summary: Dalam sidang Kongres 30 April 2026, Pete Hegseth menjawab "yes and yes"; detail programnya belum dipublikasikan.
key_points: Sidang Kongres AS, 30 April 2026: Menteri Pertahanan Pete Hegseth menjawab "yes and yes" ketika ditanya apakah Bitcoin bisa menjadi alat proyeksi kekuatan dan apakah Pentagon punya inisiatif terkait Bitcoin.
Hegseth mengungkap sebagian upaya itu masih bersifat rahasia.
Laksamana Samuel Paparo (US Indo-Pacific Command) sebelumnya mengungkap militernya menjalankan node di jaringan Bitcoin, untuk pengujian operasional, bukan mining.
Detail program rahasia Pentagon belum dipublikasikan.
why_it_matters: Bitcoin dibahas dalam konteks keamanan siber dan strategi nasional, bukan hanya sebagai aset pasar. Namun karena detail belum dipublikasikan, belum bisa dipastikan bagaimana Bitcoin dipakai di tiap program.
body: Bitcoin kini ikut dibahas dalam konteks keamanan nasional Amerika Serikat. Dalam sidang Kongres pada 30 April 2026, Menteri Pertahanan Pete Hegseth menjawab "yes and yes" ketika ditanya apakah Bitcoin bisa menjadi alat proyeksi kekuatan dan apakah Pentagon memiliki inisiatif terkait Bitcoin. Hegseth juga mengungkap bahwa sebagian upaya tersebut masih bersifat rahasia.

Sebelumnya, Laksamana Samuel Paparo, komandan US Indo-Pacific Command, mengungkap bahwa militernya sudah menjalankan node di jaringan Bitcoin. Tujuannya bukan mining, melainkan pengujian operasional untuk membantu mengamankan dan melindungi jaringan.

Teknologi kriptografi, blockchain, dan proof-of-work Bitcoin juga menarik perhatian dalam pembahasan keamanan siber dan strategi nasional. Namun, detail program rahasia Pentagon belum dipublikasikan, jadi belum bisa dipastikan secara spesifik bagaimana Bitcoin digunakan dalam setiap program tersebut.

body: Short-term holder mengirim lebih dari 36.600 BTC ke exchange dalam kondisi rugi, dalam 24 jam setelah BTC menyentuh US$76K (CryptoQuant, analis Darkfost). Dalam 7 hari, short-term holder mengirim 45.400 BTC ke Binance, tertinggi di bulan Oktober.
Darkfost sendiri menilai kapitulasi yang makin kuat bisa menandakan koreksi mendekati titik ekstrem, jadi data ini tidak otomatis berarti harga akan terus turun.

Mike McGlone (Bloomberg Intelligence): since the end of 2024, Bitcoin has lagged long-term US government bonds by about 19% (IBIT vs TLT). This is one analyst's opinion.
body_en: Short-term holders sent more than 36,600 BTC to exchanges at a loss within 24 hours after BTC touched US$76K (CryptoQuant, analyst Darkfost). Over 7 days, short-term holders sent 45,400 BTC to Binance, the highest in October.
Darkfost himself said stronger capitulation may signal the correction is nearing an extreme, so this data does not automatically mean prices will keep falling.

Mike McGlone (Bloomberg Intelligence) compared the IBIT Bitcoin ETF with the TLT US bond ETF: as of 30 Oct 2026 the ratio was 81 (100 = end of 2024), meaning Bitcoin has lagged US bonds by about 19%. This is one analyst's opinion.
why_en: Exchange inflows are often read as potential selling pressure, but this is data from one analyst and not a certainty about price direction.
analysis_en: Mike McGlone sees BTC weakness below US$80,000 as a possible sign of pressure on risk assets. This is one analyst's opinion, not a market fact.

title: Bitcoin balik ke atas US$80.000 setelah Demokrat menangi Kongres AS, nasib RUU CLARITY dipertanyakan
summary: Bitcoin pulih ke kisaran US$80.000 setelah Partai Demokrat menang di DPR dan Senat AS pada pemilu sela 3 November. Pelaku industri menilai RUU struktur pasar crypto CLARITY makin sulit lolos.
key_points: Partai Demokrat memenangi kendali DPR dan Senat AS di pemilu sela 3 November 2026. Mayoritas baru mulai bertugas 3 Januari 2027.

Menurut CoinDesk, BTC sempat turun ke dekat US$75.700 pada Rabu dini hari (waktu AS) saat hasil pemilu masuk, lalu naik ke sekitar US$80.484 pada Kamis pagi waktu Asia, naik 5,7% dalam 24 jam (data CoinGecko).
Di periode yang sama, ETH naik sekitar 8% ke ±US$2.425, dan Zcash (ZEC) naik 11,7% ke ±US$1.318 menjelang upgrade jaringan NU7.
CoinDesk mencatat minyak Brent turun lebih dari 8% pada Rabu dan S&P 500 naik 1,6%, sementara dolar AS melemah.
Stefan Muehlbauer dari CertiK kepada Cointelegraph: RUU CLARITY "kemungkinan besar mati". Jeff Mei dari BTSE kepada CoinDesk: CLARITY dalam bentuknya sekarang kecil kemungkinan lolos.
why_it_matters: RUU CLARITY dirancang untuk mengatur struktur pasar crypto di AS. Kalau macet, kepastian aturan yang ditunggu industri bisa tertunda. Muehlbauer memperkirakan Elizabeth Warren dan Maxine Waters, dua pengkritik crypto, akan memimpin Komite Perbankan Senat dan Komite Jasa Keuangan DPR.
body: Bitcoin kembali ke kisaran US$80.000 setelah Partai Demokrat memenangi kendali dua kamar Kongres AS, yaitu DPR dan Senat, dalam pemilu sela (midterm) 3 November 2026.

Menurut CoinDesk, BTC sempat turun ke dekat US$75.700 pada Rabu dini hari waktu AS saat hasil pemilu mulai masuk. Cointelegraph menyebut level itu yang terendah dalam tujuh minggu. Setelah itu harga pulih bersama saham AS: BTC kembali ke US$80.000 saat bursa Wall Street dibuka Rabu, dan diperdagangkan sekitar US$80.484 pada Kamis pagi waktu Asia, naik 5,7% dalam 24 jam menurut data CoinGecko yang dikutip CoinDesk.

Aset lain ikut naik. Menurut CoinDesk, ETH naik sekitar 8% ke ±US$2.425, sedangkan Zcash (ZEC) naik 11,7% ke ±US$1.318. Kenaikan ZEC terjadi menjelang upgrade jaringan NU7 yang diperkirakan sekitar Jumat, yang memangkas target waktu antarblok dari 75 detik menjadi 25 detik.

Dari sisi pasar global, CoinDesk mencatat minyak Brent turun lebih dari 8% pada Rabu karena investor bertaruh Kongres yang dikuasai Demokrat akan menambah tekanan untuk mengakhiri konflik di Timur Tengah. S&P 500 naik 1,6% dan dolar AS melemah.

Soal regulasi, kabarnya kurang cerah bagi industri. Stefan Muehlbauer, kepala urusan pemerintahan AS di CertiK, mengatakan kepada Cointelegraph bahwa RUU CLARITY "kemungkinan besar mati", baik di sisa masa sidang sekarang maupun di Kongres berikutnya. Jeff Mei, COO exchange BTSE, mengatakan kepada CoinDesk bahwa CLARITY dalam bentuknya sekarang kecil kemungkinan lolos.
analysis: Reaksi pasar menunjukkan investor sejauh ini lebih fokus pada hilangnya ketidakpastian pemilu, turunnya harga minyak, dan melemahnya dolar daripada pada risiko regulasi. Namun kalau RUU CLARITY benar-benar macet, industri crypto AS bisa lebih lama beroperasi tanpa kerangka aturan pasar yang jelas. Ini interpretasi, bukan prediksi harga.

title_en: Bitcoin back above US$80,000 after Democrats win the US Congress, CLARITY bill's fate in doubt
summary_en: Bitcoin recovered to around US$80,000 after the Democratic Party won the US House and Senate in the 3 November midterms. Industry figures say the CLARITY crypto market structure bill now looks harder to pass.
key_points_en: The Democratic Party won control of the US House and Senate in the 3 November 2026 midterm elections. The new majorities take office on 3 January 2027.

According to CoinDesk, BTC briefly fell toward US$75,700 early Wednesday (US time) as results came in, then rose to about US$80,484 on Thursday morning Asian time, up 5.7% in 24 hours (CoinGecko data).
Over the same period, ETH rose about 8% to ±US$2,425, and Zcash (ZEC) rose 11.7% to ±US$1,318 ahead of its NU7 network upgrade.
CoinDesk noted Brent crude fell more than 8% on Wednesday and the S&P 500 gained 1.6%, while the US dollar weakened.
CertiK's Stefan Muehlbauer told Cointelegraph the CLARITY bill is "likely dead". BTSE's Jeff Mei told CoinDesk CLARITY in its current form is unlikely to pass.
why_en: The CLARITY bill is designed to set rules for the structure of US crypto markets. If it stalls, the regulatory clarity the industry has been waiting for could be delayed. Muehlbauer expects Elizabeth Warren and Maxine Waters, two crypto critics, to chair the Senate Banking Committee and the House Financial Services Committee.
body_en: Bitcoin returned to around US$80,000 after the Democratic Party won control of both chambers of the US Congress, the House and the Senate, in the 3 November 2026 midterm elections.

According to CoinDesk, BTC briefly fell toward US$75,700 early Wednesday US time as results started coming in. Cointelegraph called it the lowest level in seven weeks. Prices then recovered along with US stocks: BTC returned to US$80,000 at Wednesday's Wall Street open, and traded around US$80,484 on Thursday morning Asian time, up 5.7% in 24 hours according to CoinGecko data cited by CoinDesk.

Other assets rose too. According to CoinDesk, ETH gained about 8% to ±US$2,425, while Zcash (ZEC) rose 11.7% to ±US$1,318. ZEC's rise came ahead of its NU7 network upgrade, expected around Friday, which cuts the target time between blocks from 75 seconds to 25 seconds.

In global markets, CoinDesk noted Brent crude fell more than 8% on Wednesday as investors bet a Democratic-controlled Congress would add pressure to end the Middle East conflict. The S&P 500 rose 1.6% and the US dollar weakened.

On regulation, the news is less upbeat for the industry. Stefan Muehlbauer, head of US government affairs at CertiK, told Cointelegraph the CLARITY bill is "likely dead", both in the remaining current session and in the next Congress. Jeff Mei, COO of exchange BTSE, told CoinDesk that CLARITY in its current form is unlikely to pass.
analysis_en: The market reaction suggests investors are, for now, focusing more on the end of election uncertainty, lower oil prices and a weaker dollar than on regulatory risk. But if the CLARITY bill really stalls, the US crypto industry could operate longer without a clear market framework. This is interpretation, not a price prediction.

title: OJK: transaksi kripto RI September 2026 tembus Rp30,56 triliun, 5 penyelenggara kena sanksi
summary: Nilai transaksi aset kripto di Indonesia naik 31,96% secara bulanan pada September 2026. OJK juga menjatuhkan sanksi ke lima penyelenggara dan menanggapi insiden keamanan Binance.
key_points: Menurut OJK, nilai transaksi aset kripto September 2026 mencapai Rp30,56 triliun, naik 31,96% dari Agustus. Transaksi derivatif aset keuangan digital (AKD) Rp5,8 triliun, naik 27,19%.
Jumlah akun konsumen AKD mencapai 23,51 juta per September 2026, naik 1,29% secara bulanan.

OJK menjatuhkan sanksi administratif ke 3 penyelenggara ITSK dan 2 penyelenggara AKD/aset kripto: 2 penghentian kegiatan tertentu, 1 denda, dan 18 peringatan tertulis. Nama perusahaan tidak disebut dalam pemberitaan.
Soal insiden Binance, OJK mengingatkan aturan POJK 27/2024: minimal 70% aset konsumen disimpan di kustodian; dari bagian yang dikelola sendiri oleh pedagang, minimal 70% wajib di cold storage.
OJK mengimbau masyarakat tetap tenang dan hanya bertransaksi lewat pedagang aset kripto yang berizin dan diawasi OJK.
why_it_matters: Lonjakan transaksi terjadi bersamaan dengan insiden keamanan besar di exchange global. Menurut POJK 27/2024 Pasal 91 ayat 1, pedagang wajib menjaga keamanan dan bertanggung jawab jika aset kripto konsumen yang mereka simpan hilang. Ini salah satu perlindungan utama bagi pengguna exchange berizin di Indonesia.
body: Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) mencatat nilai transaksi aset kripto di Indonesia mencapai Rp30,56 triliun pada September 2026, naik 31,96% dibanding Agustus. Data ini disampaikan Kepala Eksekutif Pengawas ITSK, Aset Keuangan Digital, dan Aset Kripto OJK, Adi Budiarso, dalam konferensi pers Rapat Dewan Komisioner Bulanan (RDKB) secara virtual, Kamis (5/11/2026).
Transaksi derivatif aset keuangan digital tercatat Rp5,8 triliun, naik 27,19%. Jumlah akun konsumen mencapai 23,51 juta per September 2026, tumbuh 1,29% secara bulanan.

Sanksi: OJK menjatuhkan sanksi administratif kepada tiga penyelenggara Inovasi Teknologi Sektor Keuangan (ITSK) dan dua penyelenggara aset keuangan digital/aset kripto karena melanggar POJK. Rinciannya dua sanksi penghentian kegiatan tertentu, satu denda administratif, dan 18 peringatan tertulis. Pemberitaan tidak menyebut nama perusahaan yang dikenai sanksi.

Insiden Binance: Adi menyebut insiden keamanan siber di Binance menjadi pengingat pentingnya tata kelola teknologi informasi, pengendalian akses, dan pengawasan internal. Ia menjelaskan bahwa POJK Nomor 27 Tahun 2024 mengatur aset konsumen disimpan paling sedikit 70% di pengelola tempat penyimpanan (kustodian) dan paling banyak 30% dikelola sendiri oleh pedagang. Dari bagian yang dikelola sendiri itu, paling sedikit 70% wajib di cold storage dan paling banyak 30% di hot wallet.

Pasal 91 ayat 1 POJK 27/2024 mewajibkan pedagang menjaga keamanan dan bertanggung jawab jika aset kripto konsumen yang disimpannya hilang. Menurut Adi, penyelesaian kerugian akan mempertimbangkan hasil pemeriksaan penyebab kehilangan. OJK mengimbau masyarakat tetap tenang dan hanya bertransaksi lewat penyelenggara yang berizin dan diawasi OJK.
tips: Pastikan exchange terdaftar sebagai pedagang aset keuangan digital berizin OJK.
Aktifkan 2FA berbasis aplikasi atau hardware key, bukan SMS.
Simpan aset jangka panjang di wallet yang kunci pribadinya kamu pegang sendiri.

title_en: OJK: Indonesia's crypto trading hit Rp30.56 trillion in September 2026, 5 operators sanctioned
summary_en: Crypto trading value in Indonesia rose 31.96% month on month in September 2026. OJK also sanctioned five operators and responded to the Binance security incident.
key_points_en: According to OJK, crypto asset trading value in September 2026 reached Rp30.56 trillion, up 31.96% from August. Digital financial asset (AKD) derivatives trading was Rp5.8 trillion, up 27.19%.
AKD consumer accounts reached 23.51 million as of September 2026, up 1.29% month on month.

OJK imposed administrative sanctions on 3 financial technology (ITSK) operators and 2 digital financial asset/crypto operators: 2 suspensions of certain activities, 1 fine and 18 written warnings. The companies were not named in the reports.

On the Binance incident, OJK pointed to regulation POJK 27/2024: at least 70% of customer assets must be held with a custodian; of the portion a trader manages itself, at least 70% must be in cold storage.
OJK urged the public to stay calm and only trade through crypto traders licensed and supervised by OJK.
why_en: The jump in trading came at the same time as a major security incident at a global exchange. Under Article 91(1) of POJK 27/2024, traders must keep customer crypto assets they hold secure and are responsible if those assets are lost. This is one of the main protections for users of licensed exchanges in Indonesia.
body_en: Indonesia's Financial Services Authority (OJK) recorded crypto asset trading in Indonesia of Rp30.56 trillion in September 2026, up 31.96% from August. The figures were presented by Adi Budiarso, OJK's Chief Executive for Supervision of Financial Technology, Digital Financial Assets and Crypto Assets, at the virtual press conference for the Monthly Board of Commissioners Meeting (RDKB) on Thursday (5/11/2026).
Digital financial asset derivatives trading was Rp5.8 trillion, up 27.19%. Consumer accounts reached 23.51 million as of September 2026, up 1.29% month on month.

Sanctions: OJK imposed administrative sanctions on three financial technology innovation (ITSK) operators and two digital financial asset/crypto operators for breaching OJK regulations. These consisted of two suspensions of certain activities, one administrative fine and 18 written warnings. The reports did not name the companies sanctioned.

The Binance incident: Adi said the cybersecurity incident at Binance is a reminder of the importance of IT governance, access control and internal oversight. He explained that POJK No. 27 of 2024 requires at least 70% of customer assets to be held with a custodian and at most 30% to be managed by the trader itself. Of the self-managed portion, at least 70% must be in cold storage and at most 30% in hot wallets.

Article 91(1) of POJK 27/2024 requires traders to keep customer crypto assets they hold secure and makes them responsible if those assets are lost. According to Adi, settling losses will take into account the findings on the cause of the loss. OJK urged the public to stay calm and only trade through operators licensed and supervised by OJK.
tips_title_en: Check before you use an exchange
tips_en: Make sure the exchange is an OJK-licensed digital financial asset trader.
Turn on app-based or hardware-key 2FA, not SMS.
Keep long-term holdings in a wallet whose private keys you hold yourself.

title: Ekonomi RI tumbuh 5,47% di kuartal III 2026, IHSG melonjak 2,25% dan rupiah menguat
summary: BPS mencatat pertumbuhan ekonomi Indonesia kuartal III 2026 sebesar 5,47% secara tahunan. Pada hari yang sama IHSG ditutup naik 2,25% ke 5.030 dan rupiah menguat ke Rp18.082 per dolar AS.
key_points: BPS: ekonomi Indonesia tumbuh 5,47% (yoy) di kuartal III 2026, naik dari 5,29% di kuartal II 2026 dan 5,04% di kuartal III 2025.
PDB kuartal III 2026 atas dasar harga konstan Rp3.633,2 triliun dan atas dasar harga berlaku Rp6.741,0 triliun.
IHSG ditutup naik 110,49 poin atau 2,25% ke 5.030 pada Kamis (5/11). Semua indeks sektoral menguat, dipimpin sektor barang baku (+3,6%).
Rupiah spot ditutup menguat 0,46% ke Rp18.082 per dolar AS (Bloomberg Technoz).
Phintraco Sekuritas menyebut penguatan IHSG didorong optimisme atas hasil pemilu sela AS dan data PDB yang di atas perkiraan.
why_it_matters: Bagi investor crypto di Indonesia, nilai rupiah ikut menentukan harga aset dalam rupiah. Saat rupiah menguat, harga BTC atau USDT dalam rupiah bisa naik lebih kecil dibanding kenaikannya dalam dolar AS, atau malah turun.
body: Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS) melaporkan ekonomi Indonesia tumbuh 5,47% secara tahunan (year-on-year) pada kuartal III 2026. Angka ini lebih tinggi dari 5,29% di kuartal II 2026 dan 5,04% di kuartal III 2025. Data ini disampaikan Deputi Bidang Neraca dan Analisis Statistik BPS, Moh. Edy Mahmud, di Jakarta, Kamis (5/11/2026).

PDB kuartal III 2026 atas dasar harga konstan mencapai Rp3.633,2 triliun dan atas dasar harga berlaku Rp6.741,0 triliun. Menurut CNN Indonesia, lima lapangan usaha penyumbang terbesar, yaitu industri pengolahan, pertanian, perdagangan, konstruksi, dan pertambangan, mencakup sekitar 65,31% PDB.

Pasar saham merespons positif. IHSG ditutup naik 110,49 poin atau 2,25% ke level 5.030. Menurut CNN Indonesia, seluruh indeks sektoral menguat, dipimpin sektor barang baku yang naik 3,6%. Phintraco Sekuritas, seperti dikutip Suara.com, menyebut penguatan didorong optimisme atas hasil pemilu sela AS yang dimenangkan Partai Demokrat serta data pertumbuhan ekonomi kuartal III yang di atas estimasi.

Rupiah ikut menguat. Menurut Bloomberg Technoz, rupiah spot ditutup naik 0,46% ke Rp18.082 per dolar AS, ditopang data PDB, harga minyak yang turun ke sekitar US$94 per barel, dan indeks dolar AS yang turun 0,13% ke 101,43.
analysis: Data PDB yang kuat dan meredanya ketidakpastian pemilu AS sama-sama mendorong aset berisiko, termasuk crypto yang hari ini juga naik. Tapi penguatan rupiah berarti kenaikan harga crypto dalam rupiah bisa lebih kecil dibanding dalam dolar AS. Ini interpretasi, bukan saran investasi.

title_en: Indonesia's economy grows 5.47% in Q3 2026, IHSG jumps 2.25% and the rupiah strengthens
summary_en: Statistics Indonesia (BPS) recorded Q3 2026 economic growth of 5.47% year on year. On the same day the IHSG closed up 2.25% at 5,030 and the rupiah strengthened to Rp18,082 per US dollar.
key_points_en: BPS: Indonesia's economy grew 5.47% (yoy) in Q3 2026, up from 5.29% in Q2 2026 and 5.04% in Q3 2025.
Q3 2026 GDP at constant prices was Rp3,633.2 trillion and at current prices Rp6,741.0 trillion.
The IHSG closed up 110.49 points, or 2.25%, at 5,030 on Thursday (5/11). All sector indices rose, led by basic materials (+3.6%).
The spot rupiah closed 0.46% stronger at Rp18,082 per US dollar (Bloomberg Technoz).
Phintraco Sekuritas said the IHSG's rise was driven by optimism over the US midterm results and GDP data that beat estimates.
why_en: For crypto investors in Indonesia, the rupiah's value helps determine asset prices in rupiah. When the rupiah strengthens, the rupiah price of BTC or USDT can rise less than its US dollar price, or even fall.
body_en: Statistics Indonesia (BPS) reported that Indonesia's economy grew 5.47% year on year in Q3 2026. That is higher than 5.29% in Q2 2026 and 5.04% in Q3 2025. The data was presented by BPS Deputy for Balance and Statistical Analysis Moh. Edy Mahmud in Jakarta on Thursday (5/11/2026).

Q3 2026 GDP at constant prices reached Rp3,633.2 trillion and at current prices Rp6,741.0 trillion. According to CNN Indonesia, the five largest contributing sectors, manufacturing, agriculture, trade, construction and mining, make up about 65.31% of GDP.

The stock market reacted positively. The IHSG closed up 110.49 points, or 2.25%, at 5,030. According to CNN Indonesia, all sector indices rose, led by basic materials, up 3.6%. Phintraco Sekuritas, as quoted by Suara.com, said the gains were driven by optimism over the US midterm results won by the Democratic Party and by Q3 growth data that beat estimates.

The rupiah strengthened too. According to Bloomberg Technoz, the spot rupiah closed 0.46% higher at Rp18,082 per US dollar, supported by the GDP data, oil prices falling to around US$94 a barrel, and the US dollar index falling 0.13% to 101.43.
analysis_en: Strong GDP data and fading US election uncertainty both supported risk assets, including crypto, which also rose today. But a stronger rupiah means crypto price gains in rupiah can be smaller than in US dollars. This is interpretation, not investment advice.

title: Parlemen Prancis tolak RUU anggaran 2027, aturan wajib lapor wallet crypto ikut gugur (untuk sementara)
summary: Assemblée nationale menolak bagian pendapatan RUU anggaran 2027, sehingga tiga amandemen terkait crypto, termasuk kewajiban melapor wallet self-custody senilai €100.000 ke atas, tidak ikut dibawa ke Senat.
key_points: Rabu malam, 4 November 2026 waktu Paris (Kamis pagi WITA), Assemblée nationale menolak bagian pertama (pendapatan) RUU anggaran 2027. Menurut franceinfo, penolakan bulat dari 458 anggota yang memberi suara.
Karena bagian pertama ditolak, seluruh RUU dianggap ditolak di pembacaan pertama. Senat akan membahas teks awal versi pemerintah mulai 20 November.

Menurut Cointelegraph, tiga amandemen crypto ikut gugur: pajak atas konversi crypto ke stablecoin, kewajiban melapor wallet self-custody bernilai minimal €100.000, dan kenaikan denda bagi platform crypto dari €10.000 ke €50.000.
Amandemen-amandemen itu masih bisa diajukan ulang di Senat dan harus lolos sisa proses anggaran untuk menjadi undang-undang.
why_it_matters: Kewajiban melapor wallet pribadi akan memperluas pengawasan pajak dari exchange ke wallet yang kuncinya dipegang pengguna sendiri. Untuk sekarang usulan itu tertunda, tetapi belum mati.
body: Rencana Prancis mewajibkan pemilik wallet crypto pribadi melapor ke kantor pajak tertahan dulu. Assemblée nationale (majelis rendah Prancis) menolak bagian pertama RUU anggaran negara 2027, yang mengatur pendapatan negara seperti pajak, pada Rabu malam, 4 November 2026 waktu Paris (Kamis pagi WITA).

Menurut situs resmi Assemblée nationale, karena bagian pertama tidak disetujui, seluruh RUU dianggap ditolak di pembacaan pertama berdasarkan Pasal 119 Peraturan Tata Tertib. Franceinfo melaporkan penolakan itu bulat dari 458 anggota yang memberi suara. Pemerintah akan mengirim teks awal versi pemerintah ke Senat, tanpa amandemen yang sebelumnya disetujui anggota parlemen.

Menurut Cointelegraph, ada tiga amandemen terkait crypto yang ikut gugur. Pertama, amandemen 16 Oktober yang membuat keuntungan dari konversi crypto ke stablecoin kena pajak. Kedua, amandemen yang disetujui Selasa (3/11) untuk mewajibkan wajib pajak melaporkan crypto self-custody dengan total nilai minimal €100.000 (sekitar US$112.000) per 31 Desember. Ketiga, amandemen yang menaikkan denda bagi platform crypto yang tidak memberikan informasi yang diminta otoritas pajak, dari €10.000 menjadi €50.000.
Usulan-usulan itu masih bisa diajukan lagi di Senat. Menurut Cointelegraph, Senat dijadwalkan mulai membahas RUU anggaran pada 20 November dan pasal-pasal bagian pendapatan pada 23 November.
analysis: Penolakan RUU di pembacaan pertama bukan hal baru di Prancis; kantor Perdana Menteri, menurut franceinfo, menyebutnya skenario klasik. Artinya isu pelaporan wallet pribadi masih bisa muncul lagi di Senat. Pengguna crypto di Eropa sudah dilaporkan lewat exchange berdasarkan aturan DAC8, jadi wallet self-custody tetap jadi sorotan berikutnya.

title_en: French parliament rejects 2027 budget bill, crypto wallet reporting rule falls away (for now)
summary_en: The Assemblée nationale rejected the revenue part of the 2027 budget bill, so three crypto-related amendments, including a duty to report self-custody wallets worth €100,000 or more, will not go to the Senate.
key_points_en: On Wednesday evening, 4 November 2026 Paris time (Thursday morning WITA), the Assemblée nationale rejected the first (revenue) part of the 2027 budget bill. According to franceinfo, the rejection was unanimous among the 458 members who voted.
Because the first part was rejected, the whole bill is considered rejected at first reading. The Senate will debate the government's original text from 20 November.

According to Cointelegraph, three crypto amendments fell away: a tax on crypto-to-stablecoin conversions, a duty to report self-custody wallets worth at least €100,000, and higher fines for crypto platforms, from €10,000 to €50,000.
The amendments can still be reintroduced in the Senate and would have to survive the rest of the budget process to become law.
why_en: A duty to report personal wallets would extend tax oversight from exchanges to wallets whose keys users hold themselves. For now the proposal is on hold, but it is not dead.
body_en: France's plan to require owners of personal crypto wallets to report them to the tax office is on hold for now. The Assemblée nationale (France's lower house) rejected the first part of the 2027 state budget bill, which covers government revenue such as taxes, on Wednesday evening, 4 November 2026 Paris time (Thursday morning WITA).

According to the Assemblée nationale's official website, because the first part was not adopted, the whole bill is considered rejected at first reading under Article 119 of its Rules of Procedure. Franceinfo reported the rejection was unanimous among the 458 members who voted. The government will send its original text to the Senate, without the amendments lawmakers had adopted.

According to Cointelegraph, three crypto-related amendments fell away. First, a 16 October amendment that would make gains from converting crypto into stablecoins taxable. Second, an amendment adopted on Tuesday (3/11) requiring taxpayers to report self-custodied crypto worth a total of at least €100,000 (about US$112,000) as of 31 December. Third, an amendment raising fines for crypto platforms that fail to provide information requested by tax authorities, from €10,000 to €50,000.
The proposals can still be reintroduced in the Senate. According to Cointelegraph, the Senate is scheduled to start debating the budget bill on 20 November and the revenue articles on 23 November.
analysis_en: Rejecting the bill at first reading is not new in France; the Prime Minister's office, according to franceinfo, called it the classic scenario. That means the personal wallet reporting issue could come back in the Senate. Crypto users in Europe are already reported via exchanges under the DAC8 rules, so self-custody wallets remain the next focus.

title: Bitcoin sempat sentuh level terendah sejak Agustus, ETF BTC catat arus keluar US$1,28 miliar jelang data inflasi AS
summary: Bitcoin sempat turun ke sekitar US$73.761 dan likuidasi tembus US$1 miliar. ETF bitcoin spot AS mencatat arus keluar mingguan terbesar sejak Juni, sementara data tenaga kerja AS yang kuat dan rilis CPI Oktober malam ini jadi sorotan.
key_points: Menurut CoinDesk, bitcoin sempat jatuh ke sekitar US$73.761 pada Minggu malam waktu AS (Senin, 9/11, waktu Indonesia), level terendah sejak Agustus, sebelum pulih ke atas US$75.000.
Lebih dari US$1 miliar posisi leverage crypto terlikuidasi dalam 24 jam, termasuk US$913 juta posisi long, menurut data CoinGlass yang dikutip CoinDesk.

ETF bitcoin spot AS mencatat arus keluar bersih US$1,282 miliar sepekan, terbesar sejak pekan 22–28 Juni, menurut data SoSoValue yang dikutip CoinDesk. Secara year-to-date, arus dana ETF kini minus US$914 juta.
Data resmi BLS: ekonomi AS menambah 165.000 lapangan kerja non-pertanian pada Oktober 2026, jauh di atas perkiraan, dan tingkat pengangguran turun ke 4,1%.
CPI (inflasi konsumen) AS bulan Oktober dirilis Selasa 10 November pukul 08.30 waktu New York, atau 21.30 WITA (13.30 UTC). Pada September, inflasi tahunan AS 3,7%, tertinggi sejak Mei.
why_it_matters: Data kerja yang kuat dan inflasi yang masih tinggi bisa memperkuat alasan The Fed untuk menaikkan suku bunga lagi. Suku bunga yang lebih tinggi biasanya membuat aset berisiko seperti crypto kurang menarik. Tanpa arus masuk baru ke ETF, pemulihan harga bisa lebih sulit.
body: Bitcoin kembali tertekan di awal pekan. Menurut CoinDesk, BTC sempat jatuh ke sekitar US$73.761 pada Minggu malam waktu AS (Senin, 9/11, waktu Indonesia), level terendah sejak Agustus, sebelum pulih ke atas US$75.000. Ether sempat turun di bawah US$2.100 sebelum memantul.

Gejolak harga itu memicu likuidasi paksa. Menurut data CoinGlass yang dikutip CoinDesk, lebih dari US$1 miliar posisi leverage crypto terlikuidasi dalam 24 jam, termasuk US$913 juta taruhan bahwa harga akan naik (long).

Arus dana institusi juga melemah. CoinDesk, mengutip data SoSoValue, mencatat ETF bitcoin spot yang terdaftar di AS mengalami arus keluar bersih US$1,282 miliar sepekan, terbesar sejak pekan 22–28 Juni. Empat dari lima hari perdagangan mencatat arus keluar, dan total arus dana ETF sepanjang tahun ini kini minus US$914 juta. Padahal ETF ini sempat kembali positif secara year-to-date pada 22 September.
Pada Senin waktu AS, saham justru menguat. CoinDesk mencatat Nasdaq naik 2,75% dan S&P 500 naik 2,35%, sementara bitcoin turun 1,1% ke sekitar US$74.800.

Dari sisi makro, Biro Statistik Tenaga Kerja AS (BLS) melaporkan pada Jumat (6/11) bahwa ekonomi AS menambah 165.000 lapangan kerja non-pertanian pada Oktober 2026. Menurut CNBC, angka ini jauh di atas perkiraan Dow Jones sebesar 59.000. Tingkat pengangguran turun ke 4,1% dari 4,2%, dan upah per jam naik 0,4% secara bulanan atau 3,1% secara tahunan.

Fokus berikutnya adalah CPI Oktober yang dirilis Selasa (10/11) pukul 08.30 waktu New York, atau 21.30 WITA (13.30 UTC). Menurut CoinDesk, CPI September naik 0,6% secara bulanan, mendorong inflasi tahunan ke 3,7%, tertinggi sejak Mei. CoinDesk juga menyebut CME FedWatch memperkirakan peluang kenaikan suku bunga The Fed pada Desember sebesar 85%.
analysis: Bitcoin tertinggal saat saham AS naik, dan arus keluar ETF menunjukkan permintaan institusi sedang lemah. Jika CPI malam ini lebih panas dari perkiraan, tekanan ke aset berisiko bisa bertambah. Sebaliknya, inflasi yang lebih jinak bisa sedikit meredakan tekanan. Ini interpretasi, bukan prediksi harga.

title_en: Bitcoin briefly hits its lowest since August, BTC ETFs see US$1.28 billion outflow ahead of US inflation data
summary_en: Bitcoin briefly fell to about US$73,761 and liquidations topped US$1 billion. US spot bitcoin ETFs recorded their biggest weekly outflow since June, while strong US jobs data and tonight's October CPI release are in focus.
key_points_en: According to CoinDesk, bitcoin briefly fell to about US$73,761 late Sunday US time (Monday, 9/11, Indonesia time), its lowest level since August, before recovering above US$75,000.
More than US$1 billion in leveraged crypto positions were liquidated in 24 hours, including US$913 million in long positions, according to CoinGlass data cited by CoinDesk.

US spot bitcoin ETFs recorded a net outflow of US$1.282 billion for the week, the largest since the week of 22–28 June, according to SoSoValue data cited by CoinDesk. Year to date, ETF flows are now minus US$914 million.
Official BLS data: the US economy added 165,000 nonfarm jobs in October 2026, far above expectations, and the unemployment rate fell to 4.1%.
US October CPI (consumer inflation) is released on Tuesday 10 November at 8:30 a.m. New York time, or 21.30 WITA (13.30 UTC). In September, US annual inflation was 3.7%, the highest since May.
why_en: Strong jobs data and still-high inflation could strengthen the Fed's case for raising interest rates again. Higher rates usually make risk assets such as crypto less attractive. Without fresh ETF inflows, a price recovery could be harder.
body_en: Bitcoin came under pressure again at the start of the week. According to CoinDesk, BTC briefly fell to about US$73,761 late Sunday US time (Monday, 9/11, Indonesia time), its lowest level since August, before recovering above US$75,000. Ether briefly dropped below US$2,100 before bouncing.

The price swings triggered forced liquidations. According to CoinGlass data cited by CoinDesk, more than US$1 billion in leveraged crypto positions were liquidated in 24 hours, including US$913 million in bets that prices would rise (longs).

Institutional flows also weakened. CoinDesk, citing SoSoValue data, reported that US-listed spot bitcoin ETFs saw a net outflow of US$1.282 billion for the week, the largest since the week of 22–28 June. Four of the five trading days saw outflows, and total ETF flows this year are now minus US$914 million. The ETFs had turned positive year to date on 22 September.
On Monday US time, stocks rose instead. CoinDesk noted the Nasdaq gained 2.75% and the S&P 500 rose 2.35%, while bitcoin fell 1.1% to about US$74,800.

On the macro side, the US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reported on Friday (6/11) that the US economy added 165,000 nonfarm jobs in October 2026. According to CNBC, this was far above the Dow Jones estimate of 59,000. The unemployment rate fell to 4.1% from 4.2%, and hourly pay rose 0.4% month on month, or 3.1% year on year.

The next focus is October CPI, released on Tuesday (10/11) at 8:30 a.m. New York time, or 21.30 WITA (13.30 UTC). According to CoinDesk, September CPI rose 0.6% month on month, pushing annual inflation to 3.7%, the highest since May. CoinDesk also said CME FedWatch puts the odds of a Fed rate hike in December at 85%.
analysis_en: Bitcoin lagged as US stocks rose, and ETF outflows show institutional demand is weak for now. If tonight's CPI comes in hotter than expected, pressure on risk assets could increase. Conversely, softer inflation could ease the pressure slightly. This is interpretation, not a price prediction.

title: Strategy beli lagi 1.036 BTC senilai US$81,9 juta, total kepemilikan jadi 850.364 BTC
summary: Strategy membeli 1.036 BTC pada 2–8 November 2026 dengan harga rata-rata US$79.012. Di saat yang sama, perusahaan juga membeli kembali saham preferen STRC senilai US$188,3 juta.
key_points: Menurut laporan Form 8-K ke SEC tertanggal 9 November 2026, Strategy membeli 1.036 BTC seharga ±US$81,9 juta pada 2–8 November, dengan harga rata-rata US$79.012 per BTC.
Total kepemilikan Strategy kini 850.364 BTC, dibeli dengan total biaya ±US$64,16 miliar atau rata-rata US$75.456 per BTC (termasuk biaya).
Menurut Cointelegraph, jumlah itu setara sekitar 4,05% dari batas maksimum 21 juta BTC.
Dana berasal dari penjualan saham biasa MSTR senilai ±US$283,8 juta (bersih). Sebanyak US$188,3 juta dipakai untuk membeli kembali saham preferen STRC.
Pembelian ini menyusul pembelian 811 BTC pada pekan sebelumnya.
why_it_matters: Strategy adalah perusahaan publik pemegang bitcoin terbesar di dunia. Harga rata-rata pembelian mereka (US$75.456) kini dekat dengan harga pasar BTC, jadi posisi mereka berada di sekitar titik impas. Porsi dana yang dipakai untuk buyback STRC juga lebih besar dari porsi untuk bitcoin.
body: Strategy (sebelumnya MicroStrategy), perusahaan yang dipimpin Executive Chairman Michael Saylor, kembali menambah bitcoin. Berdasarkan laporan Form 8-K ke Komisi Sekuritas dan Bursa AS (SEC) pada Senin (9/11/2026), perusahaan membeli 1.036 BTC seharga sekitar US$81,9 juta antara 2 dan 8 November 2026, dengan harga rata-rata US$79.012 per BTC.

Dengan tambahan itu, Strategy kini memegang 850.364 BTC. Menurut data Bitcoin Ledger di situs Strategy, total biaya akuisisinya sekitar US$64,16 miliar, atau rata-rata US$75.456 per BTC termasuk biaya. Cointelegraph mencatat jumlah tersebut setara sekitar 4,05% dari batas maksimum pasokan bitcoin 21 juta.

Menurut Cointelegraph, Strategy mengumpulkan dana bersih sekitar US$283,8 juta pekan lalu dari penjualan sekitar 2,05 juta saham biasa (MSTR) lewat program at-the-market. Dari jumlah itu, US$188,3 juta dipakai untuk membeli kembali sekitar 1,89 juta saham preferen STRC, US$81,9 juta untuk bitcoin, dan US$13,6 juta ditambahkan ke saldo kas.

Cointelegraph juga mencatat bahwa sejak awal Oktober, Strategy sudah menghabiskan sekitar US$1,06 miliar untuk buyback STRC, hampir lima kali lipat dari US$219,7 juta yang dipakai untuk membeli bitcoin di periode yang sama. Pada pekan sebelumnya, Strategy membeli 811 BTC seharga US$65,5 juta.
analysis: Strategy tetap membeli bitcoin setiap pekan, tetapi dalam jumlah yang jauh lebih kecil dibanding beberapa bulan lalu, dan lebih banyak dana kini dialokasikan ke buyback saham preferen. Dengan harga BTC di sekitar rata-rata biaya perusahaan, pergerakan harga akan langsung terlihat di posisi untung-rugi mereka. Ini interpretasi, bukan saran investasi.

title_en: Strategy buys another 1,036 BTC worth US$81.9 million, bringing holdings to 850,364 BTC
summary_en: Strategy bought 1,036 BTC between 2 and 8 November 2026 at an average price of US$79,012. At the same time, the company also repurchased US$188.3 million of STRC preferred shares.
key_points_en: According to a Form 8-K filed with the SEC dated 9 November 2026, Strategy bought 1,036 BTC for about US$81.9 million between 2 and 8 November, at an average price of US$79,012 per BTC.
Strategy's total holdings are now 850,364 BTC, bought for a total cost of about US$64.16 billion, or an average of US$75,456 per BTC (including fees).
According to Cointelegraph, that equals about 4.05% of the 21 million BTC maximum supply.
The funds came from selling about US$283.8 million (net) of MSTR common stock. US$188.3 million was used to buy back STRC preferred shares.
The purchase follows a purchase of 811 BTC the previous week.
why_en: Strategy is the world's largest publicly traded bitcoin holder. Its average purchase price (US$75,456) is now close to BTC's market price, so its position is around breakeven. The share of funds used for the STRC buyback was also larger than the share used for bitcoin.
body_en: Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy), the company led by Executive Chairman Michael Saylor, has added more bitcoin. According to a Form 8-K filed with the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on Monday (9/11/2026), the company bought 1,036 BTC for about US$81.9 million between 2 and 8 November 2026, at an average price of US$79,012 per BTC.

With that addition, Strategy now holds 850,364 BTC. According to the Bitcoin Ledger on Strategy's website, its total acquisition cost is about US$64.16 billion, or an average of US$75,456 per BTC including fees. Cointelegraph noted this equals about 4.05% of bitcoin's 21 million maximum supply.

According to Cointelegraph, Strategy raised net proceeds of about US$283.8 million last week by selling about 2.05 million shares of common stock (MSTR) through its at-the-market program. Of that, US$188.3 million was used to buy back about 1.89 million STRC preferred shares, US$81.9 million went to bitcoin, and US$13.6 million was added to its cash balance.

Cointelegraph also noted that since the start of October, Strategy has spent about US$1.06 billion on STRC buybacks, nearly five times the US$219.7 million it spent buying bitcoin over the same period. The previous week, Strategy bought 811 BTC for US$65.5 million.
analysis_en: Strategy keeps buying bitcoin every week, but in much smaller amounts than a few months ago, and more funds are now going to preferred share buybacks. With BTC trading around the company's average cost, price moves will show up directly in its profit-and-loss position. This is interpretation, not investment advice.

title: Coinbase resmi kantongi piagam trust bank nasional penuh dari regulator bank AS (OCC)
summary: OCC menyetujui piagam penuh Coinbase National Trust Company pada 6 November 2026. Coinbase kini bisa menjalankan layanan kustodi aset digital untuk institusi di bawah pengawasan federal AS.
key_points: Menurut catatan resmi OCC, piagam Coinbase National Trust Company berstatus "Consummated/Effective" pada 6 November 2026, setelah disetujui bersyarat pada 2 April 2026. Coinbase mengumumkannya pada 9 November.
Piagam trust nasional ini memungkinkan layanan kustodi dan pembayaran yang diawasi federal, tetapi bukan bank umum yang menerima simpanan dan menyalurkan kredit, menurut CoinDesk.
Menurut Coinbase, bisnis kustodi yang ada saat ini akan dipindahkan dari Coinbase Custody Trust Company (diawasi regulator New York, NYDFS) ke entitas baru ini secara bertahap.
CoinDesk mencatat bulan lalu OCC juga memberi piagam trust penuh ke Ripple.
Asosiasi bank komunitas AS (ICBA) menggugat OCC karena menilai pemberian piagam trust ke perusahaan crypto melampaui kewenangannya, menurut CoinDesk.
why_it_matters: Status ini menempatkan kustodi crypto Coinbase, yang dipakai banyak institusi besar, di bawah pengawasan regulator perbankan federal AS. Ini salah satu tanda makin dalamnya integrasi aset digital ke sistem keuangan tradisional AS.
body: Coinbase, exchange crypto terbesar di AS, kini resmi mengoperasikan trust bank nasional. Kantor Pengawas Mata Uang AS (Office of the Comptroller of the Currency/OCC) menyetujui piagam penuh Coinbase National Trust Company (CNTC). Menurut catatan Corporate Applications Search di situs OCC, permohonan diterima 3 Oktober 2025, disetujui bersyarat 2 April 2026, dan berstatus "Consummated/Effective" pada 6 November 2026.

Coinbase mengumumkan persetujuan itu lewat blog resminya pada Senin (9/11/2026). Perusahaan menyebut piagam ini memungkinkan bisnis kustodinya berkembang di bawah kerangka regulasi federal. Coinbase juga menyebut dirinya sebagai kustodian crypto terbesar di dunia.
Menurut CoinDesk, piagam trust nasional memungkinkan layanan kustodi dan pembayaran yang diawasi federal, tetapi tidak menjadikan Coinbase bank umum yang menerima simpanan dan memberi pinjaman.

Coinbase sebelumnya menjalankan kustodi lewat Coinbase Custody Trust Company, perusahaan trust terbatas yang diawasi Departemen Layanan Keuangan New York (NYDFS) sejak 2018. Menurut blog Coinbase, kegiatan trust tersebut kini dibawa ke kerangka federal dengan tetap berpijak pada fondasi yang dibangun bersama NYDFS.

Wakil Ketua Coinbase Ryan VanGrack, dalam pernyataan yang dikutip CoinDesk, menyebut persetujuan OCC sebagai langkah besar lain dalam mengintegrasikan aset digital ke infrastruktur inti sistem keuangan Amerika.

CoinDesk mencatat Coinbase bukan satu-satunya. Bulan lalu OCC memberi piagam trust penuh ke Ripple. Di sisi lain, Independent Community Bankers of America (ICBA) menggugat OCC karena menilai pemberian piagam trust ke perusahaan crypto melampaui kewenangan regulator itu.

title_en: Coinbase officially secures a full national trust bank charter from US bank regulator OCC
summary_en: The OCC approved the full charter of Coinbase National Trust Company on 6 November 2026. Coinbase can now run digital asset custody services for institutions under US federal supervision.
key_points_en: According to official OCC records, the Coinbase National Trust Company charter became "Consummated/Effective" on 6 November 2026, after conditional approval on 2 April 2026. Coinbase announced it on 9 November.
This national trust charter allows federally supervised custody and payment services, but it is not a full-service bank that takes deposits and extends loans, according to CoinDesk.
According to Coinbase, its existing custody business will be moved gradually from Coinbase Custody Trust Company (supervised by New York regulator NYDFS) to the new entity.
CoinDesk noted that last month the OCC also granted Ripple a full trust charter.
The US community bankers' association (ICBA) has sued the OCC, arguing that granting trust charters to crypto firms exceeds its authority, according to CoinDesk.
why_en: This status puts Coinbase's crypto custody, used by many large institutions, under the supervision of a US federal banking regulator. It is one sign of the deepening integration of digital assets into the traditional US financial system.
body_en: Coinbase, the largest US crypto exchange, now officially operates a national trust bank. The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) approved the full charter of Coinbase National Trust Company (CNTC). According to the Corporate Applications Search records on the OCC website, the application was received on 3 October 2025, conditionally approved on 2 April 2026, and became "Consummated/Effective" on 6 November 2026.

Coinbase announced the approval on its official blog on Monday (9/11/2026). The company said the charter allows its custody business to expand under a federal regulatory framework. Coinbase also described itself as the largest crypto custodian in the world.
According to CoinDesk, a national trust charter allows federally supervised custody and payment services, but does not make Coinbase a full-service bank that takes deposits and makes loans.

Coinbase previously ran custody through Coinbase Custody Trust Company, a limited-purpose trust company supervised by the New York Department of Financial Services (NYDFS) since 2018. According to Coinbase's blog, those trust activities are now being brought into a federal framework while building on the foundation developed with NYDFS.

Coinbase Vice Chairman Ryan VanGrack, in a statement cited by CoinDesk, called the OCC approval another major step in integrating digital assets into the core infrastructure of the American financial system.

CoinDesk noted Coinbase is not alone. Last month the OCC granted Ripple a full trust charter. Meanwhile, the Independent Community Bankers of America (ICBA) has sued the OCC, arguing that granting trust charters to crypto firms exceeds the regulator's authority.
