title_en: IDX changes its HSC stock methodology: list grows by 300 to 383 stocks, to be removed from the JCI calculation
summary_en: The Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX/BEI) has changed how it screens stocks with highly concentrated ownership (Hidden Shareholder Concentration, HSC). All listed stocks are now screened, and stocks of which 92.5% or more is held by 10 or fewer shareholders go on the HSC list. The total number of HSC stocks is now 383.
key_points_en: The HSC Committee's decisions were announced by IDX President Director Jeffrey Hendrik in Jakarta on Tuesday (10/11/2026).
The threshold of market capitalization above Rp5 trillion is no longer used; screening now covers all listed stocks. The price impact ratio is also no longer taken into account.
New criterion: 10 or fewer shareholders who together control 92.5% or more of the shares.
300 stocks were added, bringing the total to 383 HSC stocks (previously 83), an addition of about 6.16% of JCI market capitalization. HSC stocks are removed from the JCI (IHSG) calculation.
To leave the list, issuers must show better distribution of shares to the public through regular market transactions. The full list will be announced soon.
why_en: Stocks with a very small public portion (free float) are easier for a handful of parties to move. By removing these stocks from the JCI, index movements are expected to better reflect genuinely liquid stocks.
body_en: The Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX/BEI) announced a number of decisions by its Hidden Shareholder Concentration (HSC) Committee on Tuesday (10/11/2026). According to CNBC Indonesia, the decisions include opening the methodology to the public, changing the stock screening criteria and significantly expanding the HSC list.

IDX President Director Jeffrey Hendrik said 300 additional stocks meet the HSC criteria, bringing the total to 383 stocks, an addition of about 6.16% of JCI market capitalization. "We will soon announce the latest HSC list, which will consist of 383 stocks, or an addition of 300 new stocks that will enter the HSC list," he said at the IDX building in Jakarta, as quoted by CNBC Indonesia.

The increase is due to the new methodology. The threshold of market capitalization above Rp5 trillion is no longer used, so screening covers all listed stocks. The new methodology also no longer takes the price impact ratio into account, so designation does not have to wait for share price movements. The committee decided that stocks where 10 or fewer shareholders together control 92.5% or more of the shares go on the HSC list.

HSC stocks will be removed from the calculation of the Jakarta Composite Index (JCI/IHSG), according to CNN Indonesia and ANTARA. To leave the list, a listed company must notify the exchange that there has been better distribution of shares to the public, and that distribution must be carried out through regular market transactions. The committee will review the list regularly.

Jeffrey added that the list will be announced soon so that operations teams and data vendors can adjust the list of stocks removed from the JCI calculation. He also said the exchange will use all applicable regulations to impose sanctions if it finds inaccurate reports.
analysis_en: For retail investors, the HSC list can be a tool for spotting stocks with a thin public float that are prone to extreme price moves. Check the ownership structure before buying a stock that everyone is talking about. This is interpretation, not a stock recommendation.

title: Kazakhstan sudah tanam US$190 juta dari cadangan crypto negara senilai US$700 juta ke hedge fund dan ETF
summary: Wakil Gubernur Bank Nasional Kazakhstan Binur Zhalenov mengatakan sekitar US$190 juta dari cadangan crypto nasional senilai US$700 juta sudah diinvestasikan ke hedge fund dan ETF aset digital per akhir Oktober 2026. Ia juga menyebut Kazakhstan berinvestasi di Anthropic sejak 2025.
key_points: Angka US$190 juta disampaikan Zhalenov dalam wawancara dengan kantor berita Kazinform, yang kemudian diunggah Bank Nasional Kazakhstan.
Cadangan crypto dibentuk Desember 2025 dengan dua kontribusi masing-masing US$350 juta: dari aset emas dan devisa bank sentral, dan dari National Fund Kazakhstan.

Menurut Bloomberg (dirangkum Galaxy Research dan crypto.news), sekitar US$100 juta masuk ke fund berfokus crypto, termasuk Ege DeFi dan Brevan Howard Digital, dan sekitar US$90 juta ke aset crypto dan ETF berbasis bitcoin.
Portofolio dikelola National Investment Corporation, anak usaha Bank Nasional.
Zhalenov juga menyebut Kazakhstan berinvestasi di Anthropic pada 2025. Menurut Qazinform (Mei 2026), nilainya US$25 juta di putaran Series F.
why_it_matters: Kazakhstan termasuk sedikit negara yang memakai dana cadangan untuk masuk ke crypto, dan memilih jalur produk yang teregulasi seperti fund dan ETF, bukan membeli koin secara langsung. Ini contoh bagaimana lembaga negara mulai mengelola eksposur crypto.
body: Bank Nasional Kazakhstan mulai memutar cadangan crypto negaranya. Dalam wawancara dengan Kazinform yang dipublikasikan 9 November 2026, Wakil Gubernur Binur Zhalenov mengatakan sekitar US$190 juta dari cadangan crypto nasional senilai US$700 juta sudah diinvestasikan ke hedge fund dan exchange-traded fund (ETF) aset digital per akhir Oktober.

Menurut crypto.news yang mengutip wawancara itu, cadangan tersebut dibentuk pada Desember 2025 dengan kontribusi yang sama besar dari aset emas dan devisa bank sentral serta National Fund Kazakhstan, masing-masing US$350 juta. Portofolio dikelola National Investment Corporation, anak usaha Bank Nasional. Berdasarkan angka yang diungkap, sekitar 27% dana sudah diinvestasikan dan sekitar US$510 juta belum.

Rinciannya diungkap lebih dulu dalam sebuah konferensi di Almaty. Galaxy Research, merangkum laporan Bloomberg, menyebut sekitar US$100 juta masuk ke fund yang berfokus pada crypto, termasuk Ege DeFi dan Brevan Howard Digital. crypto.news mencatat sekitar US$90 juta lainnya masuk ke aset crypto dan ETF berbasis bitcoin; Bloomberg mengelompokkan keduanya tanpa merinci berapa porsi masing-masing.

Zhalenov juga menyebut Kazakhstan berinvestasi di Anthropic, pengembang AI Claude, pada 2025, dan valuasi perusahaan itu sudah naik berkali-kali lipat sejak itu. Menurut Qazinform pada Mei 2026, National Investment Corporation ikut putaran pendanaan Series F Anthropic di akhir 2025 dengan nilai US$25 juta, saat Anthropic dinilai sekitar US$183 miliar.

Menurut laporan yang sama, cadangan ini nantinya juga akan ditambah dengan aset digital yang disita berdasarkan putusan pengadilan dan dari penambangan strategis, namun perubahan hukum untuk keduanya masih disiapkan.
analysis: Langkah ini menunjukkan pola yang juga dicatat Galaxy Research: lembaga negara dan pengelola dana jangka panjang masuk ke crypto lewat jalur teregulasi. Nilainya masih kecil dibanding pasar crypto, jadi dampak langsung ke harga kemungkinan terbatas. Ini interpretasi, bukan prediksi harga.

title_en: Kazakhstan has put US$190 million of its US$700 million state crypto reserve into hedge funds and ETFs
summary_en: National Bank of Kazakhstan Deputy Governor Binur Zhalenov said about US$190 million of the US$700 million national crypto reserve had been invested in digital-asset hedge funds and ETFs by the end of October 2026. He also said Kazakhstan has been invested in Anthropic since 2025.
key_points_en: The US$190 million figure was given by Zhalenov in an interview with the Kazinform news agency, which was then posted by the National Bank of Kazakhstan.
The crypto reserve was set up in December 2025 with two contributions of US$350 million each: from the central bank's gold and foreign exchange assets, and from Kazakhstan's National Fund.

According to Bloomberg (summarized by Galaxy Research and crypto.news), about US$100 million went into crypto-focused funds, including Ege DeFi and Brevan Howard Digital, and about US$90 million into crypto assets and bitcoin-focused ETFs.
The portfolio is managed by the National Investment Corporation, a subsidiary of the National Bank.
Zhalenov also said Kazakhstan invested in Anthropic in 2025. According to Qazinform (May 2026), the amount was US$25 million in the Series F round.
why_en: Kazakhstan is one of only a few countries using reserve funds to enter crypto, and it has chosen regulated products such as funds and ETFs rather than buying coins directly. It is an example of how state institutions are starting to manage crypto exposure.
body_en: The National Bank of Kazakhstan has started putting its state crypto reserve to work. In an interview with Kazinform published on 9 November 2026, Deputy Governor Binur Zhalenov said about US$190 million of the US$700 million national crypto reserve had been invested in digital-asset hedge funds and exchange-traded funds (ETFs) by the end of October.

According to crypto.news, citing the interview, the reserve was set up in December 2025 with equal contributions from the central bank's gold and foreign exchange assets and Kazakhstan's National Fund, US$350 million each. The portfolio is managed by the National Investment Corporation, a subsidiary of the National Bank. Based on the disclosed figures, about 27% of the funds have been invested and about US$510 million have not.

Details were disclosed earlier at a conference in Almaty. Galaxy Research, summarizing a Bloomberg report, said about US$100 million went into crypto-focused funds, including Ege DeFi and Brevan Howard Digital. crypto.news noted that another roughly US$90 million went into crypto assets and bitcoin-focused ETFs; Bloomberg grouped the two without specifying how much went to each.

Zhalenov also said Kazakhstan invested in Anthropic, the developer of the Claude AI, in 2025, and that the company's valuation has since risen several times over. According to Qazinform in May 2026, the National Investment Corporation joined Anthropic's Series F funding round in late 2025 with US$25 million, when Anthropic was valued at about US$183 billion.

According to the same reports, the reserve will later also be topped up with digital assets confiscated by court order and from strategic mining, but the legal changes for both are still being prepared.
analysis_en: This move reflects a pattern also noted by Galaxy Research: state institutions and long-term fund managers entering crypto through regulated channels. The amount is still small relative to the crypto market, so the direct impact on prices is likely limited. This is interpretation, not a price prediction.

title: Securitize, platform tokenisasi aset, akuisisi River One dan umumkan buyback US$50 juta; saham melonjak 41%
summary: Securitize (NYSE: SECZ) melaporkan pendapatan kuartal III 2026 sebesar US$18,6 juta, naik 13%, dengan rugi bersih US$66,3 juta yang sebagian besar berasal dari biaya non-tunai terkait pencatatan saham. Perusahaan juga akan mengakuisisi River One dan mengumumkan program pembelian kembali saham US$50 juta.
key_points: Pendapatan kuartal III naik 13% secara tahunan menjadi US$18,6 juta, tertinggi kedua dalam sejarah perusahaan, menurut siaran pers resmi 9 November 2026.
Rugi bersih US$66,3 juta; sekitar US$60 juta di antaranya biaya yang sebagian besar non-tunai terkait merger dan pencatatan saham. EBITDA yang disesuaikan rugi US$2,0 juta.
Aset tertokenisasi di platform rata-rata US$5,0 miliar di kuartal III (naik 39%), dan US$4,8 miliar per 30 September.

Securitize akan mengakuisisi River One, platform pembiayaan berbasis aset (asset-backed financing) yang menghubungkan modal stablecoin dengan pasar pinjaman tradisional. Nilai transaksi tidak diungkap.
Menurut CoinDesk, saham SECZ naik 41% ke US$9,86 pada Selasa setelah Citigroup menaikkan rekomendasi menjadi buy.
why_it_matters: Tokenisasi, yaitu menaruh aset seperti dana investasi dan saham di blockchain, jadi salah satu tema besar crypto institusional. Kinerja Securitize, salah satu perusahaan tokenisasi yang sudah melantai di bursa, sering dipakai sebagai gambaran perkembangan sektor ini.
body: Securitize Corp. (NYSE: SECZ), platform tokenisasi aset yang berbasis di Miami, merilis laporan keuangan kuartal III 2026 pada Senin (9/11/2026). Menurut siaran pers resmi, pendapatan total naik 13% dibanding periode yang sama tahun lalu menjadi US$18,6 juta, angka kuartalan tertinggi kedua dalam sejarah perusahaan.

Perusahaan membukukan rugi bersih US$66,3 juta, atau US$0,41 per saham. Sekitar US$60 juta dari rugi itu, sekitar 90%, adalah biaya yang sebagian besar non-tunai dan beban akuntansi, terutama terkait merger dan pencatatan saham di bursa. EBITDA yang disesuaikan rugi US$2,0 juta, dibanding positif US$3,6 juta setahun sebelumnya. Securitize menyebut punya kas sekitar US$300 juta tanpa utang di akhir kuartal.

Dari sisi bisnis, rata-rata aset tertokenisasi di platform mencapai rekor US$5,0 miliar pada kuartal III, naik 39%, dengan total US$4,8 miliar per 30 September. Volume transaksi naik 20% menjadi US$4,3 miliar. Namun aset yang diadministrasikan oleh unit Securitize Fund Services turun 29% menjadi US$25,2 miliar.

Securitize juga mengumumkan perjanjian definitif untuk mengakuisisi River One (River Credit Labs Inc.), platform pembiayaan berbasis aset untuk institusi yang mengembangkan teknologi untuk menghubungkan modal stablecoin dengan pasar pinjaman tradisional. River One diinkubasi Framework Ventures dan didukung Maple Finance. Nilai transaksi tidak diungkap, dan penyelesaian diperkirakan pada kuartal IV 2026. Dewan direksi juga menyetujui program pembelian kembali saham hingga US$50 juta yang berlaku sampai 31 Desember 2027.

Menurut CNBC, saham Securitize naik sekitar 10% di perdagangan setelah jam bursa pada Senin. Pada Selasa, menurut CoinDesk, saham SECZ melonjak 41% ke US$9,86 setelah Citigroup menaikkan rekomendasinya dari neutral menjadi buy dengan target harga US$14, meski masih turun 17% dalam sebulan terakhir.
analysis: Lonjakan saham ini terjadi setelah penurunan besar sejak akhir September, jadi volatilitasnya tinggi. Langkah ke pembiayaan berbasis aset dengan modal stablecoin menunjukkan perusahaan tokenisasi mencari sumber pendapatan baru di luar biaya penerbitan token. Ini interpretasi, bukan rekomendasi saham.

title_en: Tokenization platform Securitize to acquire River One, announces US$50 million buyback; shares jump 41%
summary_en: Securitize (NYSE: SECZ) reported Q3 2026 revenue of US$18.6 million, up 13%, with a net loss of US$66.3 million that came mostly from non-cash costs related to its listing. The company will also acquire River One and announced a US$50 million share buyback program.
key_points_en: Q3 revenue rose 13% year on year to US$18.6 million, the second highest in the company's history, according to the official press release of 9 November 2026.
Net loss was US$66.3 million; about US$60 million of it was largely non-cash costs related to its business combination and listing. Adjusted EBITDA was a loss of US$2.0 million.
Tokenized assets on the platform averaged US$5.0 billion in Q3 (up 39%), and stood at US$4.8 billion as of 30 September.
Securitize will acquire River One, an asset-backed financing platform that connects stablecoin capital with traditional lending markets. Terms were not disclosed.
According to CoinDesk, SECZ shares rose 41% to US$9.86 on Tuesday after Citigroup upgraded them to buy.
why_en: Tokenization, putting assets such as investment funds and stocks on a blockchain, has become one of the big themes of institutional crypto. The performance of Securitize, one of the listed tokenization companies, is often used as a gauge of how the sector is developing.
body_en: Securitize Corp. (NYSE: SECZ), a Miami-based asset tokenization platform, released its Q3 2026 results on Monday (9/11/2026). According to the official press release, total revenue rose 13% from the same period a year earlier to US$18.6 million, the second-highest quarterly figure in the company's history.

The company booked a net loss of US$66.3 million, or US$0.41 per share. About US$60 million of that loss, around 90%, consisted of largely non-cash expenses and accounting charges, mainly related to its business combination and public listing. Adjusted EBITDA was a loss of US$2.0 million, compared with a positive US$3.6 million a year earlier. Securitize said it had about US$300 million in cash and no debt at the end of the quarter.

On the business side, average tokenized assets on the platform reached a record US$5.0 billion in Q3, up 39%, with a total of US$4.8 billion as of 30 September. Transaction volume rose 20% to US$4.3 billion. However, assets under administration at its Securitize Fund Services unit fell 29% to US$25.2 billion.

Securitize also announced a definitive agreement to acquire River One (River Credit Labs Inc.), an institutional asset-backed financing platform developing technology to connect stablecoin capital with traditional lending markets. River One was incubated by Framework Ventures and backed by Maple Finance. Terms were not disclosed, and the deal is expected to close in Q4 2026. The board also authorized a share repurchase program of up to US$50 million running until 31 December 2027.

According to CNBC, Securitize shares rose about 10% in after-hours trading on Monday. On Tuesday, according to CoinDesk, SECZ shares jumped 41% to US$9.86 after Citigroup upgraded the stock from neutral to buy with a US$14 price target, although it was still down 17% over the past month.
analysis_en: This jump came after a steep decline since late September, so volatility is high. The move into asset-backed financing with stablecoin capital shows tokenization companies looking for new revenue sources beyond token issuance fees. This is interpretation, not a stock recommendation.

title: Pejabat The Fed makin hawkish usai CPI panas: Logan minta minimal 2 kenaikan lagi, Goldman tambah prediksi naik Maret 2027
summary: Presiden Dallas Fed Lorie Logan menilai The Fed perlu setidaknya dua kali lagi menaikkan suku bunga 25 basis poin. Presiden Philadelphia Fed Anna Paulson juga mendukung pengetatan bertahap. Goldman Sachs kini memperkirakan kenaikan di Desember dan Maret 2027. Di Inggris, lembaga riset NIESR menilai Bank of England perlu suku bunga sekitar 5%.
key_points: Logan (10/11): "the FOMC needs to implement at least two more 25-basis-point rate increases" (FOMC perlu menaikkan suku bunga setidaknya dua kali lagi masing-masing 25 basis poin). Ia menilai suku bunga masih minimal 50 basis poin di bawah level yang cukup ketat.
Paulson (10/11): melewatkan kenaikan di rapat Oktober adalah soal tempo, bukan arah, dan untuk saat ini pengetatan bertahap lebih lanjut terlihat tepat.
Goldman Sachs tetap memperkirakan kenaikan 25 basis poin pada Desember 2026 dan menambah satu kenaikan lagi yang kemungkinan terjadi pada Maret 2027.
NIESR memperkirakan Bank of England perlu menaikkan suku bunga ke sekitar 5% agar inflasi kembali ke target 2% dalam jangka menengah. Pekan lalu BoE menaikkan suku bunga ke 4% dari 3,75%.
Laporan New York Fed: total utang rumah tangga AS naik US$334 miliar ke US$19,1 triliun di kuartal III 2026; saldo kartu kredit naik US$22 miliar ke US$1,29 triliun.
why_it_matters: Pernyataan pejabat The Fed dan proyeksi bank besar membentuk ekspektasi pasar soal arah suku bunga. Suku bunga yang lebih tinggi dan lebih lama biasanya menekan aset berisiko, termasuk saham teknologi dan crypto, serta memperkuat dolar AS.
body: Sehari setelah data inflasi konsumen (CPI) AS Oktober keluar lebih tinggi dari perkiraan, sejumlah pejabat bank sentral AS memberi sinyal bahwa kenaikan suku bunga belum selesai. Presiden Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas Lorie Logan, dalam pidato di konferensi energi bersama Fed Dallas dan Fed Kansas City di Houston pada Selasa (10/11/2026), mengatakan inflasi sedang bergerak jauh di atas target 2%.

Logan menyebut suku bunga acuan (fed funds rate) saat ini 3,88% secara nominal, dan menurut perkiraannya kisaran target suku bunga masih setidaknya 50 basis poin di bawah level yang cukup untuk mulai menekan tren inflasi. "It remains clear to me, given the current outlook, that the FOMC needs to implement at least two more 25-basis-point rate increases," katanya (Dengan prospek saat ini, bagi saya tetap jelas bahwa FOMC perlu menaikkan suku bunga setidaknya dua kali lagi masing-masing 25 basis poin). Ia menambahkan, "It may be possible to move more rapidly this winter than the FOMC has moved so far this fall" (Mungkin saja bergerak lebih cepat musim dingin ini dibanding yang dilakukan FOMC sejauh ini di musim gugur). Logan menegaskan ini pandangan pribadinya.

Presiden Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia Anna Paulson, dalam pidato pada malam yang sama, mengatakan ia mendukung kenaikan suku bunga pada September dan keputusan menahan suku bunga pada Oktober. "Skipping a meeting is a matter of pace, not direction. There is likely more work to do," ujarnya (Melewatkan satu rapat adalah soal tempo, bukan arah. Kemungkinan masih ada pekerjaan yang harus dilakukan). Paulson lebih memilih pengetatan bertahap, dan menyatakan "For now, further gradual tightening seems appropriate" (Untuk saat ini, pengetatan bertahap lebih lanjut tampaknya tepat). Ia juga menyebut inflasi PCE mencapai 3,6% dalam 12 bulan hingga September.

Dari Wall Street, ekonom Goldman Sachs David Mericle menulis bahwa setelah tiga bulan berturut-turut data inflasi memburuk, Goldman tetap memperkirakan FOMC menaikkan suku bunga 25 basis poin pada Desember, dan menambah kenaikan ketiga dalam siklus ini yang kemungkinan terjadi pada Maret 2027, menurut TheFly dan Reuters. Goldman menilai sebagian besar peserta FOMC kemungkinan akan menandakan kenaikan ketiga itu dalam proyeksi (dot plot) Desember. Rapat FOMC berikutnya dijadwalkan 8-9 Desember.

Tekanan serupa terlihat di Inggris. Lembaga riset National Institute of Economic and Social Research (NIESR) dalam prakiraan kuartalannya, menurut Reuters, menyatakan Bank of England perlu menaikkan suku bunga ke sekitar 5% untuk mengembalikan inflasi ke target dalam jangka menengah. NIESR memperkirakan inflasi Inggris memuncak 4,4% pada Februari 2027 dan baru kembali ke target pada akhir 2030. Direktur NIESR David Aikman, seperti dikutip The Guardian, mengatakan "One further quarter-point rise is unlikely to be enough" (Satu kali lagi kenaikan seperempat poin kemungkinan tidak cukup). Pekan lalu BoE menaikkan suku bunga dari 3,75% ke 4%, kenaikan pertamanya dalam lebih dari tiga tahun.

Sementara itu, laporan kuartalan Federal Reserve Bank of New York yang dirilis 10 November menunjukkan total utang rumah tangga AS naik US$334 miliar (1,8%) menjadi US$19,1 triliun pada kuartal III 2026. Saldo kartu kredit naik US$22 miliar menjadi US$1,29 triliun, dan 5,0% dari total utang berada dalam status tunggakan, naik 0,3 poin persentase dari kuartal sebelumnya.
analysis: Pesan dari para pejabat ini searah: arah suku bunga masih naik, yang berbeda hanya kecepatannya. Bagi pasar crypto, yang perlu dipantau adalah data PCE Oktober akhir bulan ini dan proyeksi suku bunga (dot plot) di rapat 8-9 Desember. Ini interpretasi, bukan prediksi harga.

title_en: Fed officials turn more hawkish after hot CPI: Logan calls for at least 2 more hikes, Goldman adds a March 2027 hike forecast
summary_en: Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan said the Fed needs to raise rates by 25 basis points at least two more times. Philadelphia Fed President Anna Paulson also backed gradual tightening. Goldman Sachs now expects hikes in December and March 2027. In the UK, the NIESR think tank said the Bank of England needs rates of around 5%.
key_points_en: Logan (10/11): "the FOMC needs to implement at least two more 25-basis-point rate increases". She estimates rates are still at least 50 basis points below a sufficiently restrictive level.
Paulson (10/11): skipping a hike at the October meeting was a matter of pace, not direction, and for now further gradual tightening seems appropriate.
Goldman Sachs still expects a 25 basis point hike in December 2026 and has added another hike likely coming in March 2027.
NIESR expects the Bank of England will need to raise rates to around 5% to bring inflation back to the 2% target in the medium term. Last week the BoE raised rates to 4% from 3.75%.
New York Fed report: total US household debt rose US$334 billion to US$19.1 trillion in Q3 2026; credit card balances rose US$22 billion to US$1.29 trillion.
why_en: Statements by Fed officials and projections from major banks shape market expectations for the path of interest rates. Higher-for-longer rates usually weigh on risk assets, including tech stocks and crypto, and strengthen the US dollar.
body_en: A day after US October consumer inflation (CPI) data came in higher than expected, several US central bank officials signaled that rate hikes are not over. Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas President Lorie Logan, in a speech at the joint Dallas Fed and Kansas City Fed energy conference in Houston on Tuesday (10/11/2026), said inflation is trending meaningfully above the 2% target.

Logan said the federal funds rate is currently 3.88% in nominal terms, and by her estimate the target range is still at least 50 basis points below the level needed to begin bringing the inflation trend down. "It remains clear to me, given the current outlook, that the FOMC needs to implement at least two more 25-basis-point rate increases," she said. She added, "It may be possible to move more rapidly this winter than the FOMC has moved so far this fall." Logan stressed these are her own views.

Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia President Anna Paulson, in a speech the same evening, said she supported the September rate hike and the decision to hold rates in October. "Skipping a meeting is a matter of pace, not direction. There is likely more work to do," she said. Paulson prefers gradual tightening and stated, "For now, further gradual tightening seems appropriate." She also noted PCE inflation reached 3.6% over the 12 months through September.

On Wall Street, Goldman Sachs economist David Mericle wrote that after three straight months of worse inflation data, Goldman still expects the FOMC to raise rates by 25 basis points in December, and has added a third hike in this cycle likely coming in March 2027, according to TheFly and Reuters. Goldman believes most FOMC participants will likely signal that third hike in the December projections (dot plot). The next FOMC meeting is scheduled for 8-9 December.

Similar pressure is visible in the UK. The National Institute of Economic and Social Research (NIESR), in its quarterly forecast, said according to Reuters that the Bank of England needs to raise rates to around 5% to bring inflation back to target in the medium term. NIESR expects UK inflation to peak at 4.4% in February 2027 and return to target only in late 2030. NIESR Director David Aikman, as quoted by The Guardian, said "One further quarter-point rise is unlikely to be enough". Last week the BoE raised rates from 3.75% to 4%, its first hike in more than three years.

Meanwhile, the Federal Reserve Bank of New York's quarterly report released on 10 November showed total US household debt rose US$334 billion (1.8%) to US$19.1 trillion in Q3 2026. Credit card balances rose US$22 billion to US$1.29 trillion, and 5.0% of total debt was in some stage of delinquency, up 0.3 percentage points from the previous quarter.
analysis_en: The message from these officials points the same way: rates are still heading higher, and the only difference is the speed. For the crypto market, the things to watch are October PCE data at the end of this month and the rate projections (dot plot) at the 8-9 December meeting. This is interpretation, not a price prediction.

title: Pendapatan OpenAI kuartal III tembus US$10 miliar, TSMC siapkan hingga US$500 juta untuk Anthropic dan OpenAI, Alibaba lanjutkan IPO unit chip
summary: Pendapatan OpenAI naik hampir 50% dari kuartal sebelumnya menjadi sekitar US$10 miliar, tetapi perusahaan masih rugi besar. Dewan TSMC menyetujui investasi maksimal US$500 juta di saham Anthropic dan maksimal US$500 juta di saham preferen OpenAI. Alibaba mendapat persetujuan HKEX untuk melanjutkan rencana spin-off unit chip T-Head.
key_points: CFO OpenAI Sarah Friar kepada Yahoo Finance: pendapatan kuartal III naik hampir 50% secara kuartalan menjadi US$10 miliar, dengan run rate tahunan sekitar US$50 miliar. Bisnis enterprise naik dua kali lipat, dan pendapatan kini terbagi 50/50 antara enterprise dan konsumen.
Menurut Wall Street Journal (via Reuters), margin operasi yang disesuaikan membaik ke -109% dari -150%, tetapi rugi operasi melebar ke US$10,9 miliar dari US$10,1 miliar.

Dewan TSMC (10/11) menyetujui anggaran modal sekitar US$40,93 miliar, dividen kuartal III NT$9 per saham, serta investasi maksimal US$500 juta di saham Anthropic (di harga IPO) dan maksimal US$500 juta di saham preferen OpenAI.
Alibaba mendapat persetujuan Bursa Hong Kong (HKEX) untuk melanjutkan rencana spin-off dan pencatatan terpisah unit chip T-Head. Ukuran IPO dan valuasi belum diungkap.
Angka TSMC adalah batas persetujuan dewan, bukan pembelian yang sudah terjadi. Listing T-Head masih butuh persetujuan Listing Committee HKEX dan pendaftaran ke regulator China (CSRC).
why_it_matters: Angka-angka ini menunjukkan uang besar masih mengalir ke AI: pendapatan pengembang model naik cepat, dan pembuat chip terbesar dunia ikut menanam modal di dua pengembang AI terbesar. Sentimen sektor AI sering ikut memengaruhi saham teknologi dan token crypto bertema AI.
body: OpenAI, pembuat ChatGPT, membagikan angka keuangan kuartal III 2026 kepada investor pada Selasa (10/11/2026). Menurut Bloomberg, pendapatan kuartalan perusahaan menembus US$10 miliar untuk pertama kalinya, naik hampir 50% dari kuartal sebelumnya dan hampir tiga kali lipat dibanding periode yang sama tahun lalu.

CFO OpenAI Sarah Friar mengonfirmasi angka itu kepada Yahoo Finance dan menyebut run rate tahunan sekitar US$50 miliar. "Our enterprise business doubled quarter over quarter," katanya (Bisnis enterprise kami naik dua kali lipat dibanding kuartal sebelumnya), seraya menambahkan bahwa pendapatan OpenAI kini terbagi 50/50 antara bisnis enterprise dan konsumen. Menurut Friar, penjualan bisnis konsumen naik 20% secara kuartalan, pelanggan berbayar melampaui 100 juta, dan pengguna aktif mingguan mencapai 1,2 miliar.

Meski begitu, OpenAI masih merugi besar. Wall Street Journal, seperti dikutip Reuters, melaporkan margin operasi yang disesuaikan membaik ke -109% dari -150% pada kuartal sebelumnya, tetapi rugi operasi melebar menjadi US$10,9 miliar dari US$10,1 miliar. OpenAI tidak langsung menanggapi permintaan komentar Reuters.

Di hari yang sama, dewan direksi TSMC (TWSE: 2330, NYSE: TSM) menyetujui anggaran modal sekitar US$40,93 miliar untuk kapasitas teknologi canggih, advanced packaging, pembangunan pabrik, dan investasi R&D 2027. Dewan juga menyetujui investasi di Anthropic dengan nilai tidak lebih dari US$500 juta untuk membeli saham biasa di harga IPO, serta investasi di OpenAI dengan nilai tidak lebih dari US$500 juta untuk membeli saham preferen. TSMC melaporkan pendapatan kuartal III NT$1.494,24 miliar dan laba bersih NT$763,06 miliar, serta menetapkan dividen tunai NT$9 per saham.

Sementara itu, Alibaba Group mengumumkan pada 10 November bahwa Bursa Hong Kong (HKEX) mengizinkan perusahaan melanjutkan rencana spin-off dan pencatatan terpisah unit chip T-Head, menurut Investing.com. T-Head telah mengajukan permohonan listing secara rahasia pada 11 September untuk mencatatkan saham H di papan utama HKEX. Penawaran akan terdiri dari penawaran umum di Hong Kong dan penempatan ke investor institusi. T-Head akan tetap menjadi anak usaha Alibaba. Alibaba belum mengungkap ukuran penawaran maupun valuasi, dan menyatakan tidak ada jaminan spin-off akan terlaksana.
analysis: Pertumbuhan pendapatan OpenAI kuat, tetapi rugi yang masih melebar menunjukkan bisnis AI frontier masih sangat mahal. Langkah TSMC ke Anthropic dan OpenAI juga datang menjelang IPO Anthropic yang dijadwalkan 19 November. Ini interpretasi, bukan rekomendasi saham atau token.

title_en: OpenAI Q3 revenue tops US$10 billion, TSMC sets aside up to US$500 million each for Anthropic and OpenAI, Alibaba moves ahead with chip unit IPO
summary_en: OpenAI's revenue rose nearly 50% from the previous quarter to about US$10 billion, but the company is still losing heavily. TSMC's board approved investments of up to US$500 million in Anthropic shares and up to US$500 million in OpenAI preferred stock. Alibaba received HKEX approval to proceed with its planned spin-off of chip unit T-Head.
key_points_en: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar to Yahoo Finance: Q3 revenue rose nearly 50% quarter on quarter to US$10 billion, with an annual run rate of about US$50 billion. The enterprise business doubled, and revenue is now split 50/50 between enterprise and consumer.
According to the Wall Street Journal (via Reuters), the adjusted operating margin improved to -109% from -150%, but the operating loss widened to US$10.9 billion from US$10.1 billion.

TSMC's board (10/11) approved capital appropriations of about US$40.93 billion, a Q3 dividend of NT$9 per share, and investments of up to US$500 million in Anthropic shares (at the IPO price) and up to US$500 million in OpenAI preferred stock.
Alibaba received approval from the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (HKEX) to proceed with the proposed spin-off and separate listing of chip unit T-Head. The IPO size and valuation have not been disclosed.

The TSMC figures are board-approved limits, not purchases that have already happened. The T-Head listing still needs approval from the HKEX Listing Committee and a filing with China's securities regulator (CSRC).
why_en: These figures show big money is still flowing into AI: model developers' revenue is rising fast, and the world's largest chipmaker is investing in the two biggest AI developers. AI sector sentiment often affects tech stocks and AI-themed crypto tokens.
body_en: OpenAI, the maker of ChatGPT, shared its Q3 2026 financial figures with investors on Tuesday (10/11/2026). According to Bloomberg, the company's quarterly revenue topped US$10 billion for the first time, up nearly 50% from the previous quarter and almost threefold from the same period a year earlier.

OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar confirmed the figure to Yahoo Finance and put the annual run rate at about US$50 billion. "Our enterprise business doubled quarter over quarter," she said, adding that OpenAI's revenue is now split 50/50 between its enterprise and consumer businesses. According to Friar, consumer sales rose 20% quarter on quarter, paid subscriptions topped 100 million and weekly active users reached 1.2 billion.

Even so, OpenAI is still losing heavily. The Wall Street Journal, as cited by Reuters, reported that the adjusted operating margin improved to -109% from -150% in the previous quarter, but the operating loss widened to US$10.9 billion from US$10.1 billion. OpenAI did not immediately respond to Reuters' request for comment.

On the same day, the board of TSMC (TWSE: 2330, NYSE: TSM) approved capital appropriations of about US$40.93 billion for advanced technology capacity, advanced packaging, fab construction and 2027 R&D investment. The board also approved an investment in Anthropic of no more than US$500 million to acquire common shares at the IPO price, and an investment in OpenAI of no more than US$500 million to acquire preferred stock. TSMC reported Q3 revenue of NT$1,494.24 billion and net income of NT$763.06 billion, and set a cash dividend of NT$9 per share.

Meanwhile, Alibaba Group announced on 10 November that the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (HKEX) had allowed it to proceed with the proposed spin-off and separate listing of chip unit T-Head, according to Investing.com. T-Head confidentially filed a listing application on 11 September to list H shares on the HKEX main board. The offering would consist of a Hong Kong public offering and a placement with institutional investors. T-Head will remain an Alibaba subsidiary. Alibaba has not disclosed the size of the offering or its valuation, and said there is no assurance the spin-off will take place.
analysis_en: OpenAI's revenue growth is strong, but the still-widening loss shows frontier AI remains very expensive. TSMC's move into Anthropic and OpenAI also comes ahead of Anthropic's IPO, scheduled for 19 November. This is interpretation, not a stock or token recommendation.

title: Perusahaan publik sudah jual 108.247 BTC sepanjang 2026, sementara Forward Industries tambah SOL dan Tron Inc. cetak laba Q3
summary: Menurut Lookonchain, 14 perusahaan publik sudah menjual 108.247 BTC senilai sekitar US$8,08 miliar tahun ini, dipimpin penambang MARA dan Riot. Di sisi lain, perusahaan treasury Solana Forward Industries menambah sekitar 226.000 SOL, dan Tron Inc. melaporkan laba bersih kuartal III US$14,9 juta.
key_points: Lookonchain (per 10 Nov): 14 perusahaan publik menjual total 108.247 BTC (~US$8,08 miliar). MARA 40.581 BTC (~US$3,03 miliar) dan Riot Platforms 20.264 BTC (~US$1,51 miliar), sekitar 56% dari total.
Banyak penjual adalah penambang yang mengalihkan modal ke infrastruktur AI dan data center. Riot menjual BTC terutama untuk membiayai pengembangan data center.
Forward Industries (NASDAQ: FWDI) menambah 226.396 SOL (+2,7%) pada 1 Okt-9 Nov 2026 menjadi 8.727.694 SOL, sekitar 1,5% suplai SOL beredar. Angka masih awal dan belum diaudit.
Forward juga mendapat fasilitas kredit US$50 juta bertenor dua tahun (SOFR + 150 bps) yang dijamin SOL, dengan SOL jaminan tetap di-stake.
Tron Inc. (Nasdaq: TRON) melaporkan laba bersih kuartal III US$14,9 juta (naik ~22%) dan laba sembilan bulan US$39,4 juta (naik ~203%). Investasi aset digitalnya US$257,8 juta per 30 September.
why_it_matters: Perusahaan publik sering dianggap sebagai pembeli besar crypto. Data ini menunjukkan gambaran yang lebih campur: sebagian besar penjual BTC adalah penambang yang butuh dana untuk bisnis AI, sementara perusahaan treasury altcoin masih menambah kepemilikan.
body: Perusahaan analitik blockchain Lookonchain mencatat 14 perusahaan publik telah menjual total 108.247 BTC, senilai sekitar US$8,08 miliar, sepanjang 2026 hingga 10 November, menurut crypto.news. Penambang MARA Holdings berada di urutan teratas dengan 40.581 BTC (sekitar US$3,03 miliar), diikuti Riot Platforms dengan 20.264 BTC (sekitar US$1,51 miliar) dan Bitdeer Technologies dengan 10.553 BTC (sekitar US$787 juta). MARA dan Riot bersama-sama menyumbang sekitar 56% dari total.

Daftar itu didominasi penambang, antara lain Cango, CleanSpark, Core Scientific, Hut 8, dan HIVE Digital. Menurut crypto.news, penjualan ini terjadi saat banyak penambang publik belanja besar untuk infrastruktur AI dan data center. Riot menjual 20.264 BTC dalam sembilan bulan pertama 2026, menghasilkan sekitar US$1,5 miliar, terutama untuk membiayai pengembangan data center. Penjualan MARA, termasuk 13.597 BTC setelah September untuk melunasi pinjaman berjaminan bitcoin US$750 juta, sudah dibahas COIN BRO sebelumnya.

Di sisi lain, Forward Industries (NASDAQ: FWDI), perusahaan treasury yang fokus pada Solana, melaporkan pada 10 November bahwa kepemilikan SOL dan setara SOL-nya naik 226.396 SOL atau 2,7% dari 30 September hingga 9 November 2026, menjadi 8.727.694 SOL, sekitar 1,5% dari suplai SOL yang beredar. Biaya rata-rata SOL tambahan itu US$75 per SOL. SOL per saham (fully diluted) naik 2,3% menjadi 0,0824.

Forward juga mendapat fasilitas kredit US$50 juta bertenor dua tahun dengan bunga SOFR + 150 basis poin dari sebuah bank nasional AS yang diasuransikan FDIC. Fasilitas itu dijamin SOL, dan SOL yang dijaminkan tetap di-stake. Perusahaan juga berkomitmen hingga US$50 juta ke USHP, produk indeks harga rumah AS yang ditokenisasi. Forward menegaskan angka-angka ini masih awal dan belum diaudit.

Sementara itu, Tron Inc. (Nasdaq: TRON), perusahaan publik pemegang token TRX terbesar, melaporkan laba bersih kuartal III 2026 sebesar US$14,9 juta, naik sekitar 22% dari US$12,2 juta setahun sebelumnya. Laba sembilan bulan pertama mencapai US$39,4 juta, naik sekitar 203%. Investasi aset digitalnya naik menjadi US$257,8 juta, dan pendapatan staking yang belum terealisasi untuk kuartal III sekitar US$3,18 juta. Laba seperti ini sebagian besar berasal dari kenaikan nilai aset digital yang belum terealisasi, sehingga bisa berbalik jika harga token turun.
analysis: Narasi bahwa perusahaan publik terus memborong crypto tidak sepenuhnya akurat untuk 2026. Penambang kini cenderung menjual BTC untuk membiayai bisnis AI, jadi tekanan jual dari kelompok ini perlu dipantau. Ini interpretasi, bukan rekomendasi.

title_en: Public companies have sold 108,247 BTC so far in 2026, while Forward Industries adds SOL and Tron Inc. posts Q3 profit
summary_en: According to Lookonchain, 14 public companies have sold 108,247 BTC worth about US$8.08 billion this year, led by miners MARA and Riot. Meanwhile, Solana treasury company Forward Industries added about 226,000 SOL, and Tron Inc. reported Q3 net income of US$14.9 million.
key_points_en: Lookonchain (as of 10 Nov): 14 public companies sold a total of 108,247 BTC (~US$8.08 billion). MARA 40,581 BTC (~US$3.03 billion) and Riot Platforms 20,264 BTC (~US$1.51 billion), about 56% of the total.
Many of the sellers are miners shifting capital to AI and data center infrastructure. Riot sold BTC mainly to fund data center development.
Forward Industries (NASDAQ: FWDI) added 226,396 SOL (+2.7%) from 1 Oct to 9 Nov 2026, reaching 8,727,694 SOL, about 1.5% of circulating SOL supply. The figures are preliminary and unaudited.
Forward also secured a two-year US$50 million credit facility (SOFR + 150 bps) secured by SOL, with the pledged SOL remaining staked.

Tron Inc. (Nasdaq: TRON) reported Q3 net income of US$14.9 million (up ~22%) and nine-month net income of US$39.4 million (up ~203%). Its digital asset investments stood at US$257.8 million as of 30 September.
why_en: Public companies are often seen as big buyers of crypto. This data paints a more mixed picture: most BTC sellers are miners who need funds for AI businesses, while altcoin treasury companies are still adding to their holdings.
body_en: Blockchain analytics firm Lookonchain counted 14 public companies that have sold a total of 108,247 BTC, worth about US$8.08 billion, during 2026 through 10 November, according to crypto.news. Miner MARA Holdings tops the list with 40,581 BTC (about US$3.03 billion), followed by Riot Platforms with 20,264 BTC (about US$1.51 billion) and Bitdeer Technologies with 10,553 BTC (about US$787 million). MARA and Riot together account for about 56% of the total.

The list is dominated by miners, including Cango, CleanSpark, Core Scientific, Hut 8 and HIVE Digital. According to crypto.news, the sales come as many public miners spend heavily on AI and data center infrastructure. Riot sold 20,264 BTC in the first nine months of 2026, raising about US$1.5 billion, mainly to fund data center development. MARA's sales, including 13,597 BTC after September to repay US$750 million of bitcoin-backed loans, have been covered by COIN BRO before.

On the other side, Forward Industries (NASDAQ: FWDI), a Solana-focused treasury company, reported on 10 November that its SOL and SOL-equivalent holdings rose by 226,396 SOL, or 2.7%, from 30 September to 9 November 2026, to 8,727,694 SOL, about 1.5% of circulating SOL supply. The average cost of the added SOL was US$75 per SOL. SOL per share (fully diluted) rose 2.3% to 0.0824.

Forward also secured a two-year US$50 million credit facility at SOFR + 150 basis points from an FDIC-insured US national bank. The facility is secured by SOL, and the pledged SOL remains staked. The company also committed up to US$50 million to USHP, a tokenized US home price index product. Forward stressed that these figures are preliminary and unaudited.

Meanwhile, Tron Inc. (Nasdaq: TRON), the public company with the largest TRX token holdings, reported Q3 2026 net income of US$14.9 million, up about 22% from US$12.2 million a year earlier. Net income for the first nine months reached US$39.4 million, up about 203%. Its digital asset investments rose to US$257.8 million, and unrealized staking income for Q3 was about US$3.18 million. Profits like these largely come from unrealized gains in the value of digital assets, so they can reverse if token prices fall.
analysis_en: The narrative that public companies keep buying up crypto is not entirely accurate for 2026. Miners now tend to sell BTC to fund AI businesses, so selling pressure from this group is worth watching. This is interpretation, not a recommendation.

title: Rangkuman regulasi AS: kasus SEC turun ke 348, Nasdaq peringatkan risiko tokenisasi, hakim tolak gugatan Novig, pendapatan Polymarket tembus US$1,8 miliar
summary: SEC mencatat 348 tindakan penegakan hukum di tahun fiskal 2026. Nasdaq meminta SEC membuat aturan tokenisasi yang netral teknologi dan saling terhubung. Seorang hakim federal di New York menolak permohonan Novig untuk menghentikan penerapan hukum judi negara bagian. Polymarket menyebut pendapatan tahunannya di atas US$1,8 miliar.
key_points: SEC (10/11): 348 tindakan penegakan di tahun fiskal yang berakhir 30 September (235 kasus mandiri, 113 lanjutan). Sanksi uang US$1,095 miliar. Menurut Reuters, jumlah kasus turun dari 456 tahun sebelumnya.

Nasdaq, dalam surat komentar ke SEC tertanggal 5 November, memperingatkan bahwa tokenisasi di blockchain yang tidak saling terhubung bisa memecah pasar menjadi "isolated liquidity silos" (silo likuiditas terpisah) dengan harga yang bisa berbeda jauh.

Hakim federal Colleen McMahon (S.D.N.Y.) pada 10 November menolak permohonan injunction awal Novig. Pengadilan menilai kontrak event olahraga Novig bukan "swap" menurut Commodity Exchange Act, sehingga New York bisa menerapkan hukum judinya.

Polymarket kepada CNBC: pendapatan tahunan (annualized) di atas US$1,8 miliar, naik dari di atas US$1 miliar pada Juni. Volume exchange AS-nya di Oktober lebih dari US$14,5 miliar (data TickerTracker).
Putusan Novig adalah putusan awal, bukan putusan akhir, dan masih bisa diajukan banding.
why_it_matters: Keempat perkembangan ini menunjukkan arah aturan main di AS untuk crypto, tokenisasi saham, dan prediction market. Siapa yang berwenang, SEC, CFTC, atau negara bagian, akan menentukan produk apa yang boleh ditawarkan dan ke siapa.
body: Komisi Sekuritas dan Bursa AS (SEC) merilis hasil penegakan hukum tahun fiskal 2026 pada Selasa (10/11/2026). SEC mencatat 348 tindakan penegakan, terdiri atas 235 kasus mandiri dan 113 proses administratif lanjutan, serta perintah sanksi uang total US$1,095 miliar: US$752 juta pengembalian keuntungan (disgorgement) plus bunga dan US$343 juta denda sipil. Menurut Reuters via MarketScreener, jumlah kasus itu turun dari 456 pada tahun sebelumnya. SEC menyatakan fokusnya pada pelanggaran serius seperti penipuan, manipulasi pasar, dan insider trading. Ketua SEC Paul Atkins mengatakan jumlah tindakan dan sanksi "are not the only or most telling measures" (bukan satu-satunya atau ukuran paling penting) keberhasilan penegakan.

Di isu tokenisasi, Nasdaq mengirim surat komentar ke SEC tertanggal 5 November 2026 terkait usulan pembaruan aturan transfer agent (berkas S7-2026-30). Nasdaq mendukung kerangka yang netral teknologi dan mengakomodasi tokenisasi, tetapi memperingatkan bahwa tokenisasi di blockchain yang tidak saling terhubung bisa memecah sistem pasar nasional menjadi "isolated liquidity silos in which prices may diverge materially from the broader market" (silo likuiditas terpisah yang harganya bisa berbeda jauh dari pasar luas). Nasdaq meminta interoperabilitas dengan sistem kliring dan settlement yang ada, serta pengungkapan informasi blockchain, wallet, dan smart contract dalam formulir pendaftaran transfer agent.

Di sektor prediction market, hakim federal Colleen McMahon dari Pengadilan Distrik Southern District of New York pada 10 November menolak permohonan injunction awal yang diajukan Ludlow Exchange (Novig) terhadap pejabat negara bagian New York. Novig, yang ditetapkan CFTC sebagai designated contract market pada 16 Juni 2026, mulai menawarkan kontrak event olahraga di New York tanpa lisensi negara bagian. Pengadilan menilai kontrak itu bukan "swap" menurut Commodity Exchange Act, sehingga New York dapat mewajibkan lisensi judi negara bagian atau melarang kontrak tersebut di platform Novig. Ini putusan awal dan masih bisa diajukan banding.

Sementara itu, Polymarket mengatakan kepada CNBC pada 10 November bahwa pendapatan tahunannya (annualized) sudah melampaui US$1,8 miliar, naik dari di atas US$1 miliar yang diungkap pada Juni. Exchange AS-nya mencatat volume notional lebih dari US$14,5 miliar di Oktober, dibanding US$4 miliar di Juni, menurut data TickerTracker, didorong event seperti Piala Dunia FIFA dan musim NFL. CNBC juga melaporkan CFTC sedang melakukan penyelidikan luas terhadap perusahaan itu. Polymarket sebelumnya mengatakan kepada CNBC bahwa mereka menyambut pengawasan.
analysis: Putusan Novig menambah ketidakpastian bagi model bisnis prediction market olahraga di AS, tepat saat volume dan pendapatan sektor ini tumbuh pesat. Untuk tokenisasi, surat Nasdaq menunjukkan bursa tradisional ingin saham token tetap terhubung ke infrastruktur pasar yang sudah ada. Ini interpretasi, bukan nasihat hukum atau finansial.

title_en: US regulation roundup: SEC cases fall to 348, Nasdaq warns of tokenization risks, judge rejects Novig's bid, Polymarket revenue tops US$1.8 billion
summary_en: The SEC recorded 348 enforcement actions in fiscal year 2026. Nasdaq asked the SEC to adopt tokenization rules that are technology-neutral and interoperable. A federal judge in New York rejected Novig's request to block enforcement of state gambling law. Polymarket said its annualized revenue is above US$1.8 billion.
key_points_en: SEC (10/11): 348 enforcement actions in the fiscal year ended 30 September (235 standalone, 113 follow-on). Monetary relief of US$1.095 billion. According to Reuters, the number of cases fell from 456 the previous year.

Nasdaq, in a comment letter to the SEC dated 5 November, warned that tokenization on non-interoperable blockchains could split the market into "isolated liquidity silos" where prices may diverge materially.

Federal judge Colleen McMahon (S.D.N.Y.) on 10 November denied Novig's motion for a preliminary injunction. The court held that Novig's sports event contracts are not "swaps" under the Commodity Exchange Act, so New York can apply its gambling law.
Polymarket to CNBC: annualized revenue above US$1.8 billion, up from above US$1 billion in June. Its US exchange volume in October was more than US$14.5 billion (TickerTracker data).
The Novig ruling is preliminary, not a final judgment, and can still be appealed.
why_en: These four developments show the direction of the rules in the US for crypto, tokenized stocks and prediction markets. Who has authority, the SEC, the CFTC or the states, will determine which products can be offered and to whom.
body_en: The US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) released its fiscal year 2026 enforcement results on Tuesday (10/11/2026). The SEC recorded 348 enforcement actions, consisting of 235 standalone actions and 113 follow-on administrative proceedings, and orders for monetary relief totaling US$1.095 billion: US$752 million in disgorgement plus prejudgment interest and US$343 million in civil penalties. According to Reuters via MarketScreener, the number of cases fell from 456 the previous year. The SEC said its focus is on serious violations such as fraud, market manipulation and insider trading. SEC Chairman Paul Atkins said the number of actions and remedies "are not the only or most telling measures" of enforcement success.

On tokenization, Nasdaq sent a comment letter to the SEC dated 5 November 2026 on the proposed update to transfer agent rules (file S7-2026-30). Nasdaq supports a technology-neutral framework that accommodates tokenization, but warned that tokenization on non-interoperable blockchains could re-fragment the national market system into "isolated liquidity silos in which prices may diverge materially from the broader market". Nasdaq asked for interoperability with existing clearing and settlement systems, as well as disclosure of blockchain, wallet and smart contract information in transfer agent registration forms.

In prediction markets, federal judge Colleen McMahon of the US District Court for the Southern District of New York on 10 November denied a motion for a preliminary injunction filed by Ludlow Exchange (Novig) against New York state officials. Novig, which the CFTC designated as a contract market on 16 June 2026, began offering sports event contracts in New York without a state license. The court held that those contracts are not "swaps" under the Commodity Exchange Act, so New York can require a state gambling license or prohibit the contracts on Novig's platform. This is a preliminary ruling and can still be appealed.

Meanwhile, Polymarket told CNBC on 10 November that its annualized revenue has surpassed US$1.8 billion, up from above US$1 billion disclosed in June. Its US exchange recorded more than US$14.5 billion in notional volume in October, compared with US$4 billion in June, according to TickerTracker data, driven by events such as the FIFA World Cup and the NFL season. CNBC also reported that the CFTC is conducting a broad investigation into the company. Polymarket previously told CNBC it welcomes scrutiny.
analysis_en: The Novig ruling adds uncertainty for the sports prediction market business model in the US, just as volume and revenue in the sector are growing fast. On tokenization, Nasdaq's letter shows traditional exchanges want tokenized stocks to stay connected to existing market infrastructure. This is interpretation, not legal or financial advice.

title: Crypto makin masuk ke pembayaran: Square tuntaskan target pembayaran Bitcoin untuk merchant AS, Visa tambah Monad, bank besar siapkan US$270 juta untuk stablecoin
summary: Square menargetkan 10 November sebagai batas akhir pengaktifan otomatis pembayaran Bitcoin via Lightning untuk merchant AS yang memenuhi syarat. Di hari yang sama, Visa menambahkan blockchain Monad ke program settlement stablecoin-nya, dan Bloomberg melaporkan Goldman Sachs, Citi, dan bank lain berkomitmen sekitar US$270 juta untuk usaha stablecoin bersama.
key_points: Square (milik Block) mulai mengaktifkan pembayaran Bitcoin secara otomatis untuk penjual AS yang memenuhi syarat sejak 30 Maret, dengan target tersedia untuk semua merchant Square pada 10 November. Pembeli membayar lewat Lightning Network; merchant menerima dolar secara default atau bisa memilih menyimpan Bitcoin.
Menurut halaman bantuan Square: biaya pemrosesan 0% hingga 31 Desember 2026, lalu 1%. Batas per transaksi setara US$600 dan US$20.000 per hari. Tidak tersedia untuk bisnis di New York.
Angka "lebih dari 4 juta merchant" yang beredar adalah ukuran jaringan Square secara keseluruhan, bukan jumlah merchant yang sudah menerima Bitcoin.

Visa menambahkan Monad sebagai opsi settlement stablecoin bagi penerbit kartu dan acquirer peserta. Visa melaporkan run rate settlement stablecoin tahunan US$25 miliar per September 2026, naik sekitar 10 kali lipat.

Menurut sumber Bloomberg, grup bank termasuk Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, Santander, dan Deutsche Bank berkomitmen sekitar US$270 juta untuk biaya operasi lima tahun perusahaan penerbit stablecoin dolar bersama (Project Faro). Angka ini belum diumumkan resmi.
why_it_matters: Ketiga kabar ini menunjukkan crypto dan stablecoin makin masuk ke infrastruktur pembayaran sehari-hari: dari kasir toko, settlement kartu, sampai bank-bank global. Penggunaan nyata seperti ini sering dianggap lebih penting untuk jangka panjang dibanding pergerakan harga harian.
body: Square, platform pembayaran milik Block yang dipimpin Jack Dorsey, mulai mengaktifkan pembayaran Bitcoin secara otomatis untuk penjual AS yang memenuhi syarat pada 30 Maret 2026, sebagai peluncuran bertahap. Saat itu, menurut Cointelegraph, pembayaran Bitcoin ditargetkan tersedia untuk semua merchant Square pada 10 November. Halaman bantuan resmi Square kini menyebut semua lokasi bisnis yang memenuhi syarat akan mengaktifkan pembayaran Bitcoin.

Cara kerjanya: pembeli memindai kode QR atau menempelkan ponsel (khusus Square Register generasi kedua) dengan wallet yang mendukung Lightning Network. Merchant menerima dolar AS secara default, karena Bitcoin langsung dikonversi saat transaksi, atau bisa memilih menerima Bitcoin. Merchant juga bisa memilih mengonversi sebagian penjualan menjadi Bitcoin. Menurut Square, biaya pemrosesan 0% hingga 31 Desember 2026 lalu menjadi 1%, batas per transaksi setara US$600 dan total US$20.000 per hari, tidak ada fitur chargeback, dan layanan tidak tersedia untuk bisnis di New York.

Angka "lebih dari 4 juta merchant" yang banyak dikutip perlu dibaca hati-hati. Menurut TokenPost, angka itu menggambarkan jaringan Square secara keseluruhan, bukan jumlah penjual yang memenuhi syarat atau yang benar-benar menerima Bitcoin. Square belum mengumumkan jumlah transaksi Bitcoin yang sudah diproses.

Masih pada 10 November, Monad Foundation mengumumkan Visa menambahkan jaringan Monad sebagai opsi settlement stablecoin, sehingga penerbit kartu dan acquirer peserta bisa menyelesaikan kewajiban Visa mereka dengan stablecoin di Monad, termasuk di akhir pekan dan hari libur. Menurut The Block, Monad bergabung dengan jaringan lain yang sudah didukung, seperti Ethereum, Solana, Avalanche, Stellar, Base, dan Polygon. Mengutip angka Visa, rilis itu menyebut run rate settlement stablecoin tahunan Visa mencapai US$25 miliar per September 2026, naik sekitar 10 kali lipat dari tahun sebelumnya, dengan lebih dari 225 program kartu terkait stablecoin. Fitur privasi Monad, Private Settlement, baru akan hadir dalam beberapa bulan ke depan.

Dari sisi perbankan, Bloomberg melaporkan, mengutip sumber yang mengetahui hal tersebut, bahwa grup lembaga keuangan termasuk Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, Banco Santander, dan Deutsche Bank berkomitmen sekitar US$270 juta untuk usaha stablecoin bersama. Dana itu untuk menutup biaya operasi lima tahun perusahaan baru yang akan menerbitkan stablecoin berdenominasi dolar dan diperkirakan berbadan hukum di AS. Menurut CoinDesk, usaha yang dikenal dengan nama Project Faro ini juga berencana membuat stablecoin untuk mata uang G7 lain, dengan prioritas euro. Grup 21 institusi ini pertama kali mengumumkan rencananya pada September dan menargetkan peluncuran pada paruh pertama 2027. Bank-bank tersebut menolak berkomentar, menurut PYMNTS yang mengutip Bloomberg.
analysis: Pembayaran Bitcoin di kasir masih bergantung pada apakah pembeli dan kasir mau memakainya, jadi dampaknya baru akan terlihat dari data transaksi nanti. Sementara itu, masuknya bank-bank besar ke stablecoin berarti persaingan dengan penerbit seperti Tether dan Circle akan makin ketat. Ini interpretasi, bukan prediksi harga.

title_en: Crypto moves further into payments: Square hits its target for Bitcoin payments at US merchants, Visa adds Monad, big banks line up US$270 million for a stablecoin
summary_en: Square set 10 November as the target date for automatically enabling Bitcoin payments via Lightning for eligible US merchants. On the same day, Visa added the Monad blockchain to its stablecoin settlement program, and Bloomberg reported that Goldman Sachs, Citi and other banks have committed about US$270 million to a joint stablecoin venture.
key_points_en: Square (owned by Block) began automatically enabling Bitcoin payments for eligible US sellers on 30 March, with a target of availability for all Square merchants by 10 November. Buyers pay via the Lightning Network; merchants receive dollars by default or can choose to keep Bitcoin.

According to Square's help page: 0% processing fee until 31 December 2026, then 1%. The limit is the equivalent of US$600 per transaction and US$20,000 per day. Not available to businesses in New York.
The widely cited "more than 4 million merchants" figure is the size of Square's overall network, not the number of merchants already accepting Bitcoin.

Visa added Monad as a stablecoin settlement option for participating card issuers and acquirers. Visa reported an annualized stablecoin settlement run rate of US$25 billion as of September 2026, up about 10x.

According to Bloomberg sources, a group of banks including Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, Santander and Deutsche Bank has committed about US$270 million to cover five years of operations for a joint dollar stablecoin issuer (Project Faro). The figure has not been officially announced.
why_en: These three stories show crypto and stablecoins moving further into everyday payment infrastructure: from shop checkouts to card settlement to global banks. Real-world use like this is often seen as more important in the long run than daily price moves.
body_en: Square, the payments platform owned by Jack Dorsey-led Block, began automatically enabling Bitcoin payments for eligible US sellers on 30 March 2026 as a phased rollout. At the time, according to Cointelegraph, Bitcoin payments were targeted to be available to all Square merchants by 10 November. Square's official help page now says all eligible business locations will have Bitcoin payments enabled.

How it works: the buyer scans a QR code or taps a phone (on second-generation Square Register only) with a Lightning Network-enabled wallet. Merchants receive US dollars by default, as the Bitcoin is converted immediately at the time of the transaction, or can choose to receive Bitcoin. Merchants can also choose to convert a portion of their sales into Bitcoin. According to Square, the processing fee is 0% until 31 December 2026 and then becomes 1%, the limit is the equivalent of US$600 per transaction and US$20,000 in total per day, there are no chargebacks, and the service is not available to businesses in New York.

The widely quoted "more than 4 million merchants" figure should be read carefully. According to TokenPost, that number describes Square's overall network, not the number of sellers that are eligible or actually accept Bitcoin. Square has not announced how many Bitcoin transactions it has processed.

Also on 10 November, the Monad Foundation announced that Visa has added the Monad network as a stablecoin settlement option, so participating card issuers and acquirers can settle their Visa obligations in stablecoins on Monad, including on weekends and holidays. According to The Block, Monad joins other supported networks such as Ethereum, Solana, Avalanche, Stellar, Base and Polygon. Citing Visa figures, the release said Visa's annualized stablecoin settlement run rate reached US$25 billion as of September 2026, up about 10x from a year earlier, with more than 225 stablecoin-linked card programs. Monad's privacy feature, Private Settlement, is due to arrive in the coming months.

On the banking side, Bloomberg reported, citing people familiar with the matter, that a group of financial institutions including Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, Banco Santander and Deutsche Bank has committed about US$270 million to a joint stablecoin venture. The funds are meant to cover five years of operating costs for a new company that will issue a dollar-denominated stablecoin and is expected to be incorporated in the US. According to CoinDesk, the venture, known as Project Faro, also plans stablecoins for other G7 currencies, with the euro as a priority. The group of 21 institutions first announced its plans in September and is targeting a launch in the first half of 2027. The banks declined to comment, according to PYMNTS citing Bloomberg.
analysis_en: Bitcoin payments at the checkout still depend on whether buyers and cashiers are willing to use them, so the impact will only show up in transaction data later. Meanwhile, big banks entering stablecoins means competition with issuers such as Tether and Circle will get tougher. This is interpretation, not a price prediction.

title: ETF Bitcoin spot AS outflow 4 hari beruntun (~US$1,14 miliar), BitMine rugi US$6,3 miliar karena ETH, nasib Strategy di indeks MSCI diumumkan besok pagi
summary: ETF Bitcoin spot AS mencatat arus keluar bersih empat hari perdagangan berturut-turut, total sekitar US$1,14 miliar. BitMine Immersion (BMNR), perusahaan treasury ETH, melaporkan rugi bersih US$6,31 miliar untuk tahun fiskal 2026, mayoritas rugi belum terealisasi. MSCI mengumumkan hasil index review November sekitar pukul 06.00 WITA 12 November, termasuk apakah Strategy (MSTR) dikeluarkan.
key_points: Data Farside: ETF Bitcoin spot AS net outflow US$430,2 juta (5/11), US$411,9 juta (6/11), US$201,0 juta (9/11), dan US$95,0 juta (10/11). Total sekitar US$1,14 miliar.

Pada 10/11, IBIT (BlackRock) -US$78,2 juta dan FBTC (Fidelity) -US$36,8 juta; MSBT (Morgan Stanley) satu-satunya yang inflow, +US$20,0 juta. Akumulasi net inflow sejak peluncuran tetap sekitar US$55,47 miliar.

Laporan 10-K BitMine (diajukan ke SEC): rugi bersih US$6.313,4 juta untuk tahun fiskal yang berakhir 31 Agustus 2026, termasuk rugi belum terealisasi aset digital US$6.229,1 juta. Tahun sebelumnya laba bersih US$348,6 juta.
Per 31 Agustus 2026 BitMine memegang 5.901.837 ETH senilai US$14.558,9 juta (sekitar 4,9% suplai ETH beredar). Pendapatan US$124,8 juta, US$121,4 juta (sekitar 97%) dari staking dan validasi.

MSCI mengumumkan hasil index review November 2026 sedikit setelah pukul 23.00 CET 11 November (sekitar 06.00 WITA 12 November). Aturan baru 15 Oktober membuat "non-operating companies" tidak layak masuk indeks global MSCI; perubahan berlaku per penutupan 30 November.
why_it_matters: Arus dana ETF adalah salah satu indikator permintaan institusi terhadap Bitcoin. Laporan BitMine menunjukkan betapa besar efek harga ETH pada laporan keuangan perusahaan treasury crypto, sementara keputusan MSCI bisa memicu penjualan saham Strategy oleh dana pasif yang mengikuti indeks.
body: ETF Bitcoin spot di AS masih ditinggalkan investor. Menurut data Farside Investors, produk-produk ini mencatat arus keluar bersih (net outflow) selama empat hari perdagangan berturut-turut: US$430,2 juta pada 5 November, US$411,9 juta pada 6 November, US$201,0 juta pada 9 November, dan US$95,0 juta pada 10 November (waktu AS). Totalnya sekitar US$1,14 miliar.

Pada 10 November, iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) milik BlackRock mencatat outflow US$78,2 juta dan Fidelity Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund (FBTC) US$36,8 juta. Satu-satunya yang mencatat inflow adalah Morgan Stanley Bitcoin Trust (MSBT), sebesar US$20,0 juta. MSBT diluncurkan Morgan Stanley Investment Management pada April 2026 dengan biaya sponsor 0,14%. Meski terus outflow, akumulasi net inflow seluruh ETF Bitcoin spot AS sejak peluncuran masih sekitar US$55,47 miliar menurut Farside.

Di sisi lain, BitMine Immersion Technologies (NYSE: BMNR), perusahaan treasury ETH dengan Executive Chairman Thomas (Tom) Lee, mengajukan laporan tahunan 10-K ke SEC pada 10 November. Untuk tahun fiskal yang berakhir 31 Agustus 2026, BitMine membukukan rugi bersih US$6.313,4 juta, berbalik dari laba bersih US$348,6 juta setahun sebelumnya. Sebagian besar rugi itu, US$6.229,1 juta, adalah rugi belum terealisasi (non-tunai) dari aset digital, terutama karena turunnya nilai wajar ETH.

Per 31 Agustus 2026, BitMine memegang 5.901.837 ETH dengan nilai wajar US$14.558,9 juta, sekitar 4,9% dari suplai ETH yang beredar saat itu, ditambah 211 BTC. Pendapatan total perusahaan US$124,8 juta, dengan US$121,4 juta atau sekitar 97% berasal dari staking dan validasi ETH. Di luar efek nilai wajar dan item non-tunai lain, perusahaan melaporkan rugi bersih disesuaikan (non-GAAP) US$80,7 juta.

Sementara itu, pasar menunggu hasil index review November dari MSCI. Menurut pengumuman MSCI, daftar penambahan dan penghapusan konstituen akan dipublikasikan sedikit setelah pukul 23.00 CET 11 November, atau sekitar pukul 06.00 WITA 12 November, dan perubahan berlaku per penutupan pasar 30 November. Ini review pertama setelah MSCI pada 15 Oktober memutuskan bahwa "non-operating companies" tidak layak masuk MSCI Global Investable Market Indexes. Konstituen yang sudah ada hanya dicoret jika gagal penyaringan di dua periode laporan tahunan terakhir.

Dalam simulasi di dokumen konsultasinya dengan data Mei 2026, MSCI menyebut Strategy (MSTR), Metaplanet, dan Yellow Cake sebagai calon yang dihapus dari indeks MSCI ACWI IMI. Daftar final bisa berbeda dan baru pasti setelah pengumuman resmi.
analysis: Outflow ETF dan rugi besar BitMine sama-sama mencerminkan harga crypto yang sedang turun, bukan masalah operasional langsung. Kalau MSCI benar mencoret Strategy, yang dijual dana pasif adalah saham MSTR, bukan Bitcoin milik Strategy. Ini interpretasi, bukan prediksi harga.

title_en: US spot Bitcoin ETFs see outflows for 4 straight days (~US$1.14 billion), BitMine loses US$6.3 billion on ETH, Strategy's MSCI index fate announced tomorrow morning
summary_en: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded net outflows for four consecutive trading days, totaling about US$1.14 billion. ETH treasury company BitMine Immersion (BMNR) reported a net loss of US$6.31 billion for fiscal 2026, mostly unrealized. MSCI announces its November index review results at around 06:00 WITA on 12 November, including whether Strategy (MSTR) is removed.
key_points_en: Farside data: US spot Bitcoin ETF net outflows of US$430.2 million (5/11), US$411.9 million (6/11), US$201.0 million (9/11) and US$95.0 million (10/11). Total about US$1.14 billion.

On 10/11, IBIT (BlackRock) saw -US$78.2 million and FBTC (Fidelity) -US$36.8 million; MSBT (Morgan Stanley) was the only fund with an inflow, +US$20.0 million. Cumulative net inflows since launch remain about US$55.47 billion.

BitMine's 10-K (filed with the SEC): net loss of US$6,313.4 million for the fiscal year ended 31 August 2026, including an unrealized loss on digital assets of US$6,229.1 million. The prior year was a net profit of US$348.6 million.

As of 31 August 2026 BitMine held 5,901,837 ETH worth US$14,558.9 million (about 4.9% of circulating ETH supply). Revenue was US$124.8 million, US$121.4 million (about 97%) from staking and validation.

MSCI announces its November 2026 index review results shortly after 23:00 CET on 11 November (about 06:00 WITA on 12 November). New rules adopted on 15 October make "non-operating companies" ineligible for MSCI's global indexes; changes take effect as of the close of 30 November.
why_en: ETF flows are one indicator of institutional demand for Bitcoin. BitMine's report shows how large the effect of the ETH price is on a crypto treasury company's financial statements, while MSCI's decision could trigger selling of Strategy shares by passive funds that track the index.
body_en: Investors are still pulling money from US spot Bitcoin ETFs. According to Farside Investors data, these products recorded net outflows for four straight trading days: US$430.2 million on 5 November, US$411.9 million on 6 November, US$201.0 million on 9 November and US$95.0 million on 10 November (US time). The total is about US$1.14 billion.

On 10 November, BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) recorded outflows of US$78.2 million and the Fidelity Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund (FBTC) US$36.8 million. The only fund with an inflow was the Morgan Stanley Bitcoin Trust (MSBT), at US$20.0 million. MSBT was launched by Morgan Stanley Investment Management in April 2026 with a 0.14% sponsor fee. Despite the continuing outflows, cumulative net inflows for all US spot Bitcoin ETFs since launch are still about US$55.47 billion, according to Farside.

Separately, BitMine Immersion Technologies (NYSE: BMNR), an ETH treasury company whose Executive Chairman is Thomas (Tom) Lee, filed its 10-K annual report with the SEC on 10 November. For the fiscal year ended 31 August 2026, BitMine booked a net loss of US$6,313.4 million, reversing a net profit of US$348.6 million a year earlier. Most of that loss, US$6,229.1 million, was an unrealized (non-cash) loss on digital assets, mainly due to the decline in ETH's fair value.

As of 31 August 2026, BitMine held 5,901,837 ETH with a fair value of US$14,558.9 million, about 4.9% of the ETH supply circulating at the time, plus 211 BTC. Total revenue was US$124.8 million, with US$121.4 million or about 97% coming from ETH staking and validation. Excluding fair-value effects and other non-cash items, the company reported an adjusted (non-GAAP) net loss of US$80.7 million.

Meanwhile, the market is waiting for MSCI's November index review. According to MSCI's announcement, the list of constituent additions and deletions will be posted shortly after 23:00 CET on 11 November, or about 06:00 WITA on 12 November, with changes taking effect as of the market close on 30 November. This is the first review since MSCI decided on 15 October that "non-operating companies" are ineligible for the MSCI Global Investable Market Indexes. Existing constituents are removed only if they fail the screen in each of their two most recent annual filing periods.

In a simulation in its consultation paper using May 2026 data, MSCI named Strategy (MSTR), Metaplanet and Yellow Cake as candidates for deletion from the MSCI ACWI IMI. The final list may differ and is only certain after the official announcement.
analysis_en: ETF outflows and BitMine's huge loss both reflect falling crypto prices, not a direct operational problem. If MSCI does remove Strategy, what passive funds sell is MSTR stock, not Strategy's Bitcoin. This is interpretation, not a price prediction.

title: Google DeepMind rilis Gemini Robotics 2.5, robot humanoid sukses 96% di pabrik Mercedes-Benz; pendapatan CoreWeave naik 168%
summary: Google DeepMind memperkenalkan Gemini Robotics 2.5, model vision-language-action (VLA) paling canggih mereka, yang diuji di lini produksi Mercedes-Benz dengan robot Apollo 2 dari Apptronik. Di sisi infrastruktur AI, CoreWeave melaporkan pendapatan kuartal III US$3,66 miliar dan menaikkan panduan 2026.
key_points: DeepMind (10/11): Gemini Robotics 2.5 mencapai tingkat sukses 30% sampai 100% lebih tinggi dibanding baseline sebelumnya, tergantung jenis tugas, dan menyelesaikan tugas 20% sampai 30% lebih cepat. Diuji pada lebih dari 200 tugas berbeda.
Uji coba di lini produksi Mercedes-Benz di Kecskemét (Hungaria) dan Sindelfingen (Jerman): robot humanoid Apollo 2 dari Apptronik mengambil dan menyusun komponen otomotif dengan tingkat sukses 96%.
DeepMind merilis ASIMOV-Jailbreak, benchmark open-source untuk menguji ketahanan robot terhadap perintah berbahaya yang disamarkan. Model ini sedang digulirkan ke mitra robotika DeepMind.
CoreWeave (10/11): pendapatan kuartal III US$3,66 miliar, naik 168% dari sekitar US$1,36 miliar setahun sebelumnya, di atas estimasi LSEG US$3,55 miliar. Rugi bersih US$709 juta.

CoreWeave menaikkan panduan pendapatan 2026 menjadi US$13 miliar sampai US$13,3 miliar. Menurut CNBC, sahamnya sudah turun sekitar 40% dalam sebulan terakhir dan naik di perdagangan setelah jam bursa.
why_it_matters: Robot yang bisa bekerja andal di pabrik sungguhan adalah salah satu tahap berikutnya dari AI. Sementara itu, hasil CoreWeave menjadi indikator apakah permintaan infrastruktur AI masih kuat di tengah suku bunga tinggi, yang sering ikut menggerakkan sentimen saham teknologi dan token crypto bertema AI.
body: Google DeepMind pada Selasa (10/11/2026) memperkenalkan Gemini Robotics 2.5, yang mereka sebut sebagai model vision-language-action (VLA) paling mampu sejauh ini. Model VLA adalah model AI yang menggabungkan penglihatan, pemahaman bahasa, dan perintah gerakan untuk mengendalikan robot. DeepMind menguji model ini pada lebih dari 200 tugas berbeda, seperti menyajikan makanan dengan penjepit, mengikat pita pada kotak hadiah, dan memindahkan cairan dengan pipet.

Menurut DeepMind, dibanding baseline sebelumnya, Gemini Robotics 2.5 mencapai tingkat sukses 30% sampai 100% lebih tinggi tergantung jenis tugas, dan menyelesaikan tugas 20% sampai 30% lebih cepat. Model ini bekerja dengan berbagai jenis robot, termasuk robot humanoid Apollo 2 dari Apptronik dan platform Franka Duo.

Uji di dunia nyata dilakukan bersama Apptronik dan Mercedes-Benz di lini produksi otomotif aktif di Kecskemét, Hungaria, dan Sindelfingen, Jerman. Robot Apollo 2 mengerjakan "kitting" otomotif, yaitu memilah komponen dari wadah besar ke nampan sesuai urutan yang dibutuhkan tiap kendaraan, dengan tingkat sukses 96%. CEO Apptronik Jeff Cardenas menulis, "This is what we built Apollo for: useful work alongside people in real industrial settings" (Untuk inilah kami membangun Apollo: pekerjaan yang berguna di samping manusia di lingkungan industri nyata).

Dari sisi keamanan, DeepMind merilis ASIMOV-Jailbreak, benchmark open-source berisi ratusan perintah yang menyamarkan permintaan berbahaya. Menurut DeepMind, model Gemini 4 Argon mencapai ketahanan jailbreak 99,5%, dibanding 82% pada baseline sebelumnya. Gemini Robotics 2.5 sedang digulirkan ke mitra robotika DeepMind.

Di sektor infrastruktur AI, penyedia cloud GPU CoreWeave melaporkan pendapatan kuartal III 2026 sebesar US$3,66 miliar, naik 168% dari sekitar US$1,36 miliar setahun sebelumnya dan di atas konsensus LSEG US$3,55 miliar, menurut CNBC. Rugi bersihnya US$709 juta, dibanding rugi US$110 juta setahun sebelumnya. Perusahaan menaikkan panduan pendapatan 2026 menjadi US$13 miliar sampai US$13,3 miliar, dan backlog pendapatannya kini US$132,5 miliar.

Menurut CNBC, saham CoreWeave sudah kehilangan lebih dari 40% nilainya dalam sebulan terakhir karena investor keluar dari saham infrastruktur AI dan suku bunga yang naik mempersulit pendanaan. Saham ini naik di perdagangan setelah jam bursa usai laporan dirilis. CoreWeave mencatat utang hampir US$47 miliar di akhir kuartal III.
analysis: Angka 96% dari DeepMind berasal dari uji coba (proof-of-concept) dan diumumkan oleh DeepMind sendiri, belum audit independen. Hasil CoreWeave menunjukkan permintaan AI masih kuat, tetapi biaya utang tetap jadi risiko utama sektor ini. Ini interpretasi, bukan rekomendasi saham atau token.
